If they have the fewest hand cards, they draw one card; if they have the lowest HP Value, they recover 1 HP; if they have the fewest cards in their Equipment Zone, they Use a random Equipment Card. skills.description_cn: 出牌阶段，牌堆顶的七张牌对你可见。你的【火攻】结算中，你可观看并选择牌堆顶七张牌中的一张牌代替【火攻】弃牌。
skills.description_en: During your Play Phase, the top seven cards of the deck are visible to you. When resolving your Fire Attack, you may look at the top seven cards and choose one as a Substitute for Fire Attack's discard.

skills.description_cn: 锁定技，你的回合内，有牌不因使用而进入弃牌堆后，你使用的下一张牌无次数限制；每回合首次有不为手牌的牌进入弃牌堆后，你摸一张牌。
skills.description_en: Compulsory. During your turn, after cards enter the discard pile other than through Use, the next card you Use has no usage limit. The first time each turn cards that were not hand cards enter the discard pile, draw one card.

skills.description_cn: 转换技，阳：出牌阶段，你可将牌堆顶的一张牌当【火攻】使用；阴：将一种颜色的手牌置入弃牌堆（每种颜色每回合限一次），然后可视为使用其中一张基本牌或普通锦囊牌。若你以此法未造成伤害，你令〖知天〗可见牌与观看牌数-1（至多减至1），然后你摸两张牌。
skills.description_en: Conversion. Yang: during your Play Phase, you may Use the top card of the deck as Fire Attack. Yin: put all hand cards of one color into the discard pile, each color once per turn, then you may be treated as Using a Basic or Non-Time-Delayed Tool Card among them. If you deal no damage this way, reduce Know Heaven's visible and viewed card count by 1, to a minimum of 1, then draw two cards.

skills.description_cn: 限定技，回合开始时，你可选择一名其他角色。本回合你的每个阶段开始时，你可弃置一张牌视为对其使用一张【杀】。当其成为此【杀】的目标后，其可弃置一张基本牌或武器牌令此【杀】无效。
skills.description_en: Limited. At the start of your turn, you may choose another character. At the start of each phase this turn, you may discard one card to be treated as Using Slash on them. After they become its target, they may discard a Basic Card or weapon to Nullify that Slash.

skills.description_cn: 锁定技。你使用【杀】时，若你使用的上一张牌未造成伤害，则你摸一张牌并令此【杀】伤害+1。此【杀】结算后，若仍未造成伤害，你弃置一张牌。
skills.description_en: Compulsory. When you Use Slash, if the previous card you Used dealt no damage, draw one card and increase that Slash's damage by 1. After it resolves, if it also dealt no damage, discard one card.

skills.description_cn: 锁定技，回合开始时，你选择一项：1.回复过1点体力；2.弃置过两张牌；3.使用过三种类型的牌；4.造成过4点伤害。然后本回合结束时你摸X张牌，若未满足选择的条件，则删除此选项（X为你最后一次发动〖矜名〗选择的选项序号）。
skills.description_en: Compulsory. At the start of your turn, choose a condition: recover 1 HP; discard two cards; Use all three card types; or deal 4 damage. At the end of this turn, draw X cards, then remove the chosen option if you did not meet its condition. X is the option number chosen the last time you activated Pride in Renown.

skills.description_cn: 出牌阶段限一次，你使用牌可以额外指定一个目标（无距离限制）。此牌结算完毕后，若此牌未造成过伤害，你失去1点体力或令其中一个目标摸X张牌（X为你最后一次发动〖矜名〗选择的选项序号）。
skills.description_en: Once per Play Phase, you may add one target with no distance limit to a card you Use. After it resolves, if it dealt no damage, Lose 1 HP or have one of its targets draw X cards. X is the last option number you chose for Pride in Renown.

skills.description_cn: 主公技，其他群势力角色的出牌阶段限一次，其可以交给你一张装备牌，视为使用一张【酒】。
skills.description_en: Lord. Once during each other Qun character's Play Phase, they may give you one Equipment Card to be treated as Using Wine.

skills.description_cn: 其他角色使用牌指定第一个目标后，若此牌指定的目标数大于1，则你可以弃置一张与此牌颜色相同的牌并令此牌改为对其中一名目标角色结算两次。
skills.description_en: After another character's card designates its first target, if it has more than one target, you may discard a card of the same color to change it to resolve twice against just one of those targets.

skills.description_cn: 出牌阶段限一次，当你使用【杀】指定目标后，你可以令所有可成为此牌目标的其他角色均成为此牌目标，此牌结算完毕后，若你因此牌造成的伤害值X：大于你的手牌数，你摸X张牌（至多摸五张）；大于你的体力值，你再次对所有目标角色中可以成为此牌目标的角色使用此牌。
skills.description_en: Once per Play Phase, after you target a character with Slash, you may make every eligible other character a target. After it resolves, let X be the damage it dealt. If X exceeds your hand size, draw X cards, up to five. If X exceeds your HP Value, Use that card again on all its original targets who remain eligible.

skills.description_cn: 游戏开始时，你将〖思召剑〗置入装备区。
skills.description_en: At game start, place the Sizhao Sword in your Equipment Zone.

skills.description_cn: 主公技，其他群势力角色失去装备区的牌后，若你的装备区中没有武器牌，其可将〖思召剑〗置入你的装备区。
skills.description_en: Lord. After another Qun character loses cards from their Equipment Zone, if you have no weapon equipped, they may place the Sizhao Sword in your Equipment Zone.

skills.description_cn: 当你使用有点数的【杀】指定目标后，你令目标角色只能使用无点数或点数大于等于此【杀】的【闪】响应此牌。
skills.description_en: After your Slash with a rank designates a target, that target may respond only with a Dodge whose rank is absent or at least the Slash's rank.

skills.description_cn: 转换技，出牌阶段，阳：你可以将一张黑色牌当【过河拆桥】使用：阴：你可以将一张红色牌当【火攻】使用。结算后，你可将因此弃置的牌置于牌堆顶。
skills.description_en: Conversion. During your Play Phase, Yang: you may Use a black card as Dismantle; Yin: you may Use a red card as Fire Attack. After resolution, you may put the cards discarded by that effect on top of the deck.

skills.description_cn: 你造成或受到伤害后，你可令一名：有转换技的角色切换其一个转换技的状态：无转换技的角色获得出牌阶段各限一次的〖迁附〗，直到其失去最后的手牌。每轮前X次，有转换技切换状态后，你摸一张牌（X为你的体力上限）。
skills.description_en: After you deal or Take damage, you may have a character with a Conversion skill switch one of its states, or have a character without one gain Shifting Allegiance, each option once per Play Phase, until they lose their last hand card. The first X times each round a Conversion skill changes state, draw one card, where X is your Max HP.

skills.description_cn: 限定技，结束阶段，你可以令一名角色获得弃牌堆中的伤害牌（不超过存活人数）且令这些牌造成伤害时改为火焰伤害。
skills.description_en: Limited. During your End Phase, you may have one character gain damage cards from the discard pile, up to the number of living characters. Damage those cards deal becomes fire damage.

skills.description_cn: 出牌阶段限一次，你可展示并交给至多两名其他角色各一张牌，这些牌本轮称为“迷落”牌。每轮结束时，你可令其中一名手牌中没有/有“迷落”牌的角色失去/回复1点体力。
skills.description_en: Once per Play Phase, you may Show and give one card each to up to two other characters. Those cards are Bewilderment cards this round. At the end of each round, you may have one recipient Lose 1 HP if their hand contains no Bewilderment card, or recover 1 HP if it does.

skills.description_cn: 每轮各限一次，当你需要使用手牌中一张普通锦囊牌或红色基本牌时，可改为展示并视为使用之；你每轮首次展示一种花色的手牌后摸一张牌。
skills.description_en: Each option once per round. When you need to Use a Non-Time-Delayed Tool Card or red Basic Card from your hand, you may instead Show it and be treated as Using it. After the first time each round you Show a hand card of each suit, draw one card.

skills.description_cn: 你使用的锦囊牌进入弃牌堆后，你可以令一名角色依次执行X次摸一张牌和X次弃置一张牌（X为本回合弃牌堆缺少的花色数），然后若其手牌数变为体力值，令其下家执行剩余流程。
skills.description_en: After a Tool Card you Used enters the discard pile, you may have one character draw one card X times, then discard one card X times, where X is the number of suits missing from the discard pile this turn. If their hand size becomes equal to their HP Value, have the next character perform the remaining steps.

skills.description_cn: 你需要使用普通锦囊牌时，可以将本回合进入弃牌堆的任意张花色各不相同的牌移出游戏并失去〖金烬〗，视为使用之；然后你于下个受到过伤害的回合结束时令一名角色获得移出游戏的牌和〖金烬〗。
skills.description_en: When you need to Use a Non-Time-Delayed Tool Card, you may remove from the game any number of cards with different suits that entered the discard pile this turn, lose Golden Embers, and be treated as Using that Tool Card. At the end of the next turn in which you Take damage, have one character gain the removed cards and Golden Embers.

skills.description_cn: 出牌阶段，你可将任意张牌当作【决斗】使用（至多五张，且选择的转化牌数不得为你本回合发动〖轮战〗已经转化过的牌数）。若你因此对唯一目标造成了伤害，你可以摸X张牌，然后你本回合不能再对其发动此技能（X为本回合你使用牌指定其为目标的次数）。
skills.description_en: During your Play Phase, you may Use up to five cards as Duel, choosing a number you have not previously used for this skill this turn. If it deals damage to its sole target, you may draw X cards, then cannot activate this skill against that character again this turn. X is the number of times your cards have targeted them this turn.

skills.description_cn: 锁定技，当你于回合内首次仅使用所有手牌指定仅一名其他角色为目标时，你令其弃置X张牌（X为本回合你使用牌指定其为目标的次数）。
skills.description_en: Compulsory. The first time during your turn you Use exactly all your hand cards to target exactly one other character, have them discard X cards, where X is the number of times your cards have targeted them this turn.

source_reference.label: Chinese rules reference · Noname
source_reference.note: English translated from this pinned community rules record. The publisher confirms this name in the Shenmo box; compare the Chinese skills with your printed card to confirm its revision. Digital updates can differ from physical printings.

skills.description_cn: 每回合限一次，当你成为其他角色使用基本牌或普通锦囊牌的唯一目标时，你可以令此牌额外结算一次。若如此做，此牌结算完毕后，你摸X张牌（X为你的攻击范围且至多为5）。
skills.description_en: Once per turn, when you are the sole target of another character's Basic or Non-Time-Delayed Tool Card, you may have it resolve one additional time. After it finishes, draw cards equal to your Attack Range, up to five.

skills.description_cn: 锁定技，准备阶段，你从牌堆中获得一张【决斗】，若牌堆没有【决斗】，则你的攻击范围和出牌阶段使用【杀】的次数上限+1（增加次数不超过本局游戏人数）。
skills.description_en: Compulsory. During your Preparation Phase, gain a Duel from the deck. If none is available, increase your Attack Range and your Play Phase Slash limit by 1. These increases cannot occur more times than the number of players in the game.

source_reference.label: Chinese rules reference · Noname
source_reference.note: English translated from this pinned community rules record. The publisher confirms this name in the Shenmo box; compare the Chinese skills with your printed card to confirm its revision. Digital updates can differ from physical printings.

skills.description_cn: 每回合各限一次，当你使用【杀】或【决斗】指定唯一目标后，你可以令此牌伤害值基数+1。若此牌未造成伤害，你可以令目标角色视为对你使用一张【杀】。
skills.description_en: Each card name once per turn. After you Use Slash or Duel on a sole target, you may increase its Base Damage Value by 1. If it deals no damage, you may have the target be treated as Using Slash on you.

skills.description_cn: 你的体力值变化后，若你体力值大于0且为你首次达到，你可以选择一名角色并选择一项：1.令其摸X张牌，然后弃置一张牌；2.令其摸一张牌，然后其弃置X张牌（X为你已损失体力值且至少为1）。
skills.description_en: After your HP Value changes to a positive value you have never reached before, you may choose a character: have them draw X cards then discard one; or draw one then discard X. X is your lost HP, with a minimum of 1.

source_reference.label: Chinese rules reference · Noname
source_reference.note: English translated from this pinned community rules record. The publisher confirms this name in the Shenmo box; compare the Chinese skills with your printed card to confirm its revision. Digital updates can differ from physical printings.

skills.description_cn: 一名角色的阶段结束时，若你于此阶段得到过至少两张牌，你可以摸三张牌，展示三张手牌，令一名其他角色选择是否使用其中一张牌并令你随机弃置其中另一张牌。若使用牌的点数于三张牌中满足以下条件，其获得如下技能或效果直到其下一个回合的回合结束：唯一最大，其获得〖飞军〗；不为最大且不为最小，其获得〖潜袭〗；唯一最小，其手牌上限+2。若其未以此法使用牌，你对其与你各造成1点火焰伤害。
skills.description_en: At the end of a character's phase, if you gained at least two cards during it, you may draw three cards and Show three hand cards. Another character may Use one and have you randomly discard one of the other two. If the Used card has the uniquely highest rank, they gain Flying Army; if neither highest nor lowest, they gain Hidden Assault; if uniquely lowest, their Hand Limit increases by 2. This lasts until the end of their next turn. If they Use none, deal 1 fire damage to both them and yourself.

skills.description_cn: 当你每回合首次受到伤害时，若伤害来源为你或在你的攻击范围内，你可以弃置一张红色牌，防止此伤害。
skills.description_en: The first time you Take damage each turn, if its source is yourself or within your Attack Range, you may discard a red card to prevent that damage.

skills.description_cn: 出牌阶段限一次。你可以弃置一张牌，然后选择一项：⒈令一名手牌数大于你的角色交给你一张牌；⒉令一名装备区里牌数大于你的角色弃置一张装备牌。
skills.description_en: Once per Play Phase, you may discard one card, then choose: have a character with more hand cards than you give you one card; or have a character with more equipped cards than you discard one Equipment Card.

skills.description_cn: 准备阶段，你可以摸一张牌，并弃置一张牌，然后令一名距离为1的角色不能使用或打出与你弃置的牌颜色相同的手牌直到回合结束。
skills.description_en: During your Preparation Phase, you may draw one card and discard one card, then prevent a character at Distance 1 from Using or Playing hand cards matching that discarded card's color until turn end.

source_reference.label: Chinese rules reference · Noname
source_reference.note: English translated from this pinned community rules record. The publisher confirms this name in the Shenmo box; compare the Chinese skills with your printed card to confirm its revision. Digital updates can differ from physical printings.

skills.description_cn: 回合开始时，你可以摸一张牌，跳过本回合判定、摸牌、出牌和弃牌阶段中的一个阶段（每阶段限一次），并交换其中另外两个阶段。
skills.description_en: At the start of your turn, you may draw one card, skip one of this turn's Judgment, Draw, Play, or Discard Phases, each phase once, and exchange two of the other phases.

skills.description_cn: 出牌阶段各限一次，你可以令一名角色：1.失去1点体力，下个摸牌阶段摸牌数+2；2.摸两张牌，下个弃牌阶段手牌上限-2。
skills.description_en: Each option once per Play Phase, you may have a character: Lose 1 HP and draw two additional cards in their next Draw Phase; or draw two cards and have their Hand Limit reduced by 2 in their next Discard Phase.

skills.description_cn: 限定技，结束阶段，你可以选择两名其他角色并失去X点体力（X为这两名角色体力值之差且不能为0），令这两名角色交换体力值。然后直到其中一名角色死亡，每回合结束时，你摸一张牌并回复1点体力。
skills.description_en: Limited. During your End Phase, you may choose two other characters with different HP Values and Lose HP equal to that difference. Exchange their HP Values. Until one of them dies, at the end of every turn, draw one card and recover 1 HP.

source_reference.label: Chinese rules reference · Noname
source_reference.note: English translated from this pinned community rules record. The publisher confirms this name in the Shenmo box; compare the Chinese skills with your printed card to confirm its revision. Digital updates can differ from physical printings.

skills.description_cn: 每回合限一次。①当你使用伤害牌指定唯一目标时，你可以弃置任意张红色牌令目标弃置等量红色手牌，否则不能响应该牌；②以你为目标的伤害牌结算完成后，若未对你造成伤害，你可以弃置一张黑色牌并视为使用一张【杀】。
skills.description_en: Once per turn: when your damage card designates a sole target, you may discard any number of red cards; they must discard that many red hand cards or cannot respond to it. Alternatively, after a damage card targeting you resolves without damaging you, you may discard a black card to be treated as Using Slash.

skills.description_cn: 每轮限一次，当你的手牌数变化后，若为全场最少，你可将手牌摸至体力上限，然后本回合下一次有角色造成伤害时，此伤害+1。
skills.description_en: Once per round, after your hand size changes, if it is the lowest, you may draw until it equals your Max HP. The next damage dealt by any character this turn increases by 1.

source_reference.label: Chinese rules reference · Noname
source_reference.note: English translated from this pinned community rules record. The publisher confirms this name in the Shenmo box; compare the Chinese skills with your printed card to confirm its revision. Digital updates can differ from physical printings.

skills.description_cn: ①游戏开始时，你获得3枚“贤”标记（一名角色的“贤”标记上限为5）。②当你使用或打出牌后，若此牌与你使用或打出的上一张牌的花色或类型相同，则你获得1枚“贤”标记。③回合结束时，你依次执行：⒈你可以将任意枚“贤”标记分配给等量其他角色；⒉场上所有有“贤”标记的角色按照“贤”标记由大到小的顺序（“贤”标记数相同的角色按座次逆时针排序）依次选择是否使用一张手牌，若不选择使用，则其移去所有“贤”标记，然后你摸等量的牌。
skills.description_en: At game start, gain three Virtue tokens; each character can hold at most five. After you Use or Play a card matching the suit or type of the card you previously Used or Played, gain one Virtue. At turn end, you may distribute any number of Virtue tokens to that many other characters. All characters with Virtue then choose in order of descending Virtue count, ties counterclockwise, whether to Use one hand card. Anyone who declines removes all their Virtue, and you draw that many cards.

skills.description_cn: 当一名有“贤”标记的角色受到非属性伤害时，其以外所有有“贤”标记的角色同时选择是否取消此伤害，所有角色选择完毕后，若有角色选择是，则取消此伤害，然后选择是的角色中体力值最大的一名角色依次失去X点体力（X为伤害值）。
skills.description_en: When a character with Virtue Takes normal damage, all other characters with Virtue simultaneously choose whether to cancel it. If anyone agrees, cancel the damage. Among those who agreed, the character with the highest HP Value Loses HP equal to that damage, resolving in order if tied.

source_reference.label: Chinese rules reference · Noname
source_reference.note: English translated from this pinned community rules record. The publisher confirms this name in the Shenmo box; compare the Chinese skills with your printed card to confirm its revision. Digital updates can differ from physical printings.

skills.description_cn: 你的阶段结束时，若你本阶段失去过手牌或得到过牌，则你可以与一名角色拼点。若你赢，你可以使用其中一张拼点牌；若你没赢，你失去1点体力或令此技能于本回合无效。
skills.description_en: At the end of one of your phases, if you lost hand cards or gained cards during it, you may Pindian with a character. If you win, you may Use one Pindian card. Otherwise, Lose 1 HP or disable this skill for the turn.

skills.description_cn: 限定技，结束阶段。若你本回合使用过牌的阶段数大于等于/小于等于体力值，你可以获得技能〖困奋〗/〖诈降〗（同时满足则都获得，以此法获得的〖困奋〗直接修改为非锁定技）。若如此做，你将手牌数调整至手牌上限或将体力值回复至体力上限，然后你不能回复体力直到你杀死角色。
skills.description_en: Limited. During your End Phase, if the number of phases in which you Used cards this turn is at least your HP Value, you may gain Hardship; if at most your HP Value, gain Feigned Surrender. Gain both if both apply. Hardship gained this way is optional. Then adjust your hand size to your Hand Limit or recover to your Max HP. You cannot recover HP until you kill a character.

skills.description_cn: 结束阶段开始时，你可以失去1点体力，然后摸两张牌。
skills.description_en: At the start of your End Phase, you may Lose 1 HP, then draw two cards.

skills.description_cn: 锁定技。当你失去1点体力后，你摸三张牌。然后若此时是你的出牌阶段，则你本回合获得此下效果：使用【杀】的次数上限+1，使用红色【杀】无距离限制且不能被【闪】响应。
skills.description_en: Compulsory. After you Lose each 1 HP, draw three cards. If it is your Play Phase, increase your Slash limit by 1 this turn; red Slashes you Use this turn have no distance limit and cannot be responded to with Dodge.

skills.description_cn: 当你受到伤害后，你可将一张牌当【无中生有】使用。当你以此法使用过三种不同牌名的锦囊牌后，此技能于你的结束阶段也可发动。
skills.description_en: After you Take damage, you may Use one card as Draw Two. After you have Used three different Tool Card names this way, you may also activate this skill during your End Phase.

skills.description_cn: 每回合第一张基本牌被使用时，你可重铸一张牌。若两张牌均为伤害类或非伤害类，则此牌额外结算一次。然后若重铸的牌为锦囊牌，你为〖理贤〗添加一个牌名：【顺手牵羊】；【过河拆桥】；【铁索连环】。以上牌名均添加后，〖理贤〗于你的准备阶段也可发动。
skills.description_en: When the first Basic Card of a turn is Used, you may Recast one card. If both cards are damage cards or both are non-damage cards, that Basic Card resolves one additional time. If the Recast card is a Tool Card, add one name to Honor the Worthy: Steal, Dismantle, or Iron Chain. Once all are added, Honor the Worthy may also activate during your Preparation Phase.

source_reference.note: English translated from this pinned community rules record. The publisher confirms this name in the Shenmo box; compare the Chinese skills with your printed card to confirm its revision. Digital updates can differ from physical printings.

skills.description_cn: 出牌阶段限两次，你可以选择一名其他角色，然后同时与其选择摸一张牌或弃置一张牌，然后若你与其的手牌数之和的变化值为：0，你与其依次弃置对方一张牌；2，你与其依次视为对对方使用一张【杀】。
skills.description_en: Twice per Play Phase, you may choose another character. Simultaneously, each chooses to draw one card or discard one card. If the combined change in your hand sizes is 0, each discards one card from the other, in order. If it is 2, each is treated as Using Slash on the other, in order.

skills.description_cn: 锁定技。当你于摸牌/弃牌阶段外摸/弃置了本回合的第二张牌后，你下一次造成/受到的伤害+1。
skills.description_en: Compulsory. After you draw your second card this turn outside a Draw Phase, your next damage dealt increases by 1. After you discard your second card this turn outside a Discard Phase, your next damage Taken increases by 1.

source_reference.note: English translated from this pinned community rules record. The publisher confirms this name in the Shenmo box; compare the Chinese skills with your printed card to confirm its revision. Digital updates can differ from physical printings.

skills.description_cn: 每回合限一次，你可以将一张牌当作任意【杀】或【酒】使用，且目标角色本回合与此牌颜色相同的手牌均视为【杀】。
skills.description_en: Once per turn, you may Use one card as any Slash or Wine. Its targets' hand cards of the same color are treated as Slashes for this turn.

skills.description_cn: 锁定技。①你每回合使用的第一张红色牌无距离限制。②你每回合使用的第一张基本牌不计入使用次数。③你每回合第一次造成伤害后，你摸一张牌。
skills.description_en: Compulsory. Your first red card each turn has no distance limit. Your first Basic Card each turn does not count toward its usage limit. After you deal damage for the first time each turn, draw one card.

source_reference.label: Chinese rules reference · Noname
source_reference.note: English translated from this pinned community rules record. The publisher confirms this name in the Shenmo box; compare the Chinese skills with your printed card to confirm its revision. Digital updates can differ from physical printings.

skills.description_cn: 锁定技。①你的攻击范围视为你的体力值。②当你使用【杀】指定唯一目标时，若其攻击范围：小于等于你，你令此牌造成的伤害+1，获得其一张手牌；大于等于你，你弃置其区域一张牌，选择一名角色作为此牌的额外目标。
skills.description_en: Compulsory. Your Attack Range is treated as your HP Value. When your Slash designates a sole target: if their Attack Range is at most yours, increase its damage by 1 and gain one of their hand cards; if at least yours, discard one card from their zones and add one character as a target. Both apply when equal.

skills.description_cn: 出牌阶段限一次，你可以令一名其他角色的攻击范围+1或-1（至多减至1）直到你的下个出牌阶段开始。
skills.description_en: Once per Play Phase, you may increase or decrease another character's Attack Range by 1, to a minimum of 1, until your next Play Phase begins.

source_reference.label: Chinese rules reference · Noname
source_reference.note: English translated from this pinned community rules record. The publisher confirms this name in the Shenmo box; compare the Chinese skills with your printed card to confirm its revision. Digital updates can differ from physical printings.

skills.description_cn: 锁定技。①游戏开始时，你的手牌上限、其他角色计算与你的距离、你计算与其他角色的距离+X（X为游戏人数）。②首轮结束时，或当你发动〖凶逆〗或〖封赏〗后，你失去〖观变〗。
skills.description_en: Compulsory. At game start, increase your Hand Limit, other characters' Distance to you, and your Distance to them by the number of players. Lose Observe Change at the end of the first round or after activating Savage Rebellion or Bestow Rewards.

skills.description_cn: 出牌阶段开始时，你可以弃置一张牌，然后所有其他角色选择一项：1.弃置一张与此牌花色相同的牌；2.受到你的1点伤害。
skills.description_en: At the start of your Play Phase, you may discard one card. Every other character then chooses: discard a card of the same suit; or take 1 damage from you.

skills.description_cn: 出牌阶段限一次或有角色进入濒死状态时（每回合限一次），你可以将两张本回合进入弃牌堆中的本轮未以此法选择过的相同花色的牌分配给等量角色。若你未以此法获得牌，你视为使用一张不计入次数的【酒】。
skills.description_en: Once per Play Phase, or when a character enters a Dying Event, once per turn, you may distribute two same-suit cards that entered the discard pile this turn and were not chosen this way this round to two characters. If you gain no card this way, you are treated as Using Wine without counting toward its usage limit.

skills.description_cn: 主公技，锁定技。准备阶段，若其他群势力角色累计使用黑色牌的次数达到：三张，你增加1点体力上限并回复1点体力；六张，你获得〖焚城〗；九张：你获得〖崩坏〗。
skills.description_en: Lord; compulsory. During your Preparation Phase, if other Qun characters have cumulatively Used three black cards, increase your Max HP by 1 and recover 1 HP; at six, gain Burn the City; at nine, gain Collapse.

skills.description_cn: 限定技。出牌阶段，你可以指定一名其他角色，令从其开始的其他角色依次选择一项：⒈弃置至少X张牌（X为上一名角色弃置的牌数+1）。⒉你对其造成2点火焰伤害。
skills.description_en: Limited. During your Play Phase, choose another character. Starting with them, every other character chooses in order: discard at least one more card than the previous character discarded; or take 2 fire damage from you.

skills.description_cn: 锁定技。结束阶段，若你的体力不为全场最少，你失去1点体力或减1点体力上限。
skills.description_en: Compulsory. During your End Phase, if your HP Value is not the lowest, Lose 1 HP or reduce your Max HP by 1.

source_reference.label: Chinese rules reference · Noname
source_reference.note: English translated from this pinned community rules record. The publisher confirms this name in the Shenmo box; compare the Chinese skills with your printed card to confirm its revision. Digital updates can differ from physical printings.

skills.description_cn: 锁定技。一名角色于其出牌阶段外使用的牌进入弃牌堆后，若“谷”的数量小于你的体力上限，你将其中的非♥牌置于你的武将牌上，称为“谷”。体力上限与你相同的角色的回合开始时，你可以用任意张手牌替换等量“谷”。
skills.description_en: Compulsory. After a card Used outside its user's Play Phase enters the discard pile, if your Grain count is below your Max HP, place its non-heart physical cards on your General Card as Grain. At the start of a character's turn whose Max HP matches yours, you may Replace and keep any number of Grain cards using an equal number of hand cards.

skills.description_cn: ①每个准备阶段，你可以减少1点体力上限或移去两张“谷”，然后将一张手牌当距离限制为X的【顺手牵羊】使用（X为你的“谷”数且至少为1）。②每个结束阶段，若你的手牌数与“谷”的数量相同且你的体力上限不为全场唯一最高，你增加1点体力上限。
skills.description_en: During every Preparation Phase, you may reduce your Max HP by 1 or remove two Grain, then Use a hand card as Steal with Distance limit X, where X is your Grain count, minimum 1. During every End Phase, if your hand size equals your Grain count and your Max HP is not uniquely highest, increase your Max HP by 1.

source_reference.label: Chinese rules reference · Noname
source_reference.note: English translated from this pinned community rules record. The publisher confirms this name in the Shenmo box; compare the Chinese skills with your printed card to confirm its revision. Digital updates can differ from physical printings.

skills.description_cn: 出牌阶段，你可以选择一名有手牌的其他角色并从1/2/3中选择一个数字X，其可以选择是否交给你至多三张手牌。若其交给你的牌数Y：不小于X，则你与其各摸一张牌；小于X，则其下Z次受到的伤害+1（Z为X与Y之差）。若Z不小于2，则其获得〖自矜〗。然后此技能失效直到下X轮游戏开始时。
skills.description_en: During your Play Phase, choose another character with hand cards and a number X from 1 to 3. They may give you up to three hand cards, Y. If Y is at least X, each of you draws one card; otherwise, their next X-Y instances of damage Taken increase by 1. If X-Y is at least 2, they gain Self-Restraint. Disable this skill until the start of the Xth following round.

skills.description_cn: 当你于其他角色的出牌阶段内首次成为红色【杀】/黑色普通锦囊牌的目标后，你可以弃置你/其的一张牌，令此牌对你无效。
skills.description_en: During another character's Play Phase, after you first become a target of a red Slash, you may discard one of your cards to Nullify it against you. After you first become a target of a black Non-Time-Delayed Tool Card, you may discard one of their cards to Nullify it against you.

skills.description_cn: 锁定技，当你使用牌结算结束后，若此牌未造成过伤害，你须弃置一张牌或失去1点体力。
skills.description_en: Compulsory. After a card you Use resolves without dealing damage, you must discard one card or Lose 1 HP.

source_reference.label: Chinese rules reference · Noname
source_reference.note: English translated from this pinned community rules record. The publisher confirms this name in the Shenmo box; compare the Chinese skills with your printed card to confirm its revision. Digital updates can differ from physical printings.

skills.description_cn: 锁定技，有角色受到火焰伤害后，你下一次使用火【杀】或【火攻】可以额外指定1个目标（不可叠加），你使用火【杀】或【火攻】造成的伤害+X (X为全场势力数)。
skills.description_en: Compulsory. After a character Takes fire damage, your next Fire Slash or Fire Attack may have one extra target; this does not stack. Your Fire Slashes and Fire Attacks deal X additional damage, where X is the number of factions present.

skills.description_cn: 转换技。①游戏开始时，你可以转换此技能状态；②每回合限一次，当你对其他角色使用牌后，你可以选择其中一名目标角色：阳，你将手牌数摸至与其相同（至多摸五张），然后视为对其使用一张【火攻】；阴，令一名手牌数为全场最大的角色对其使用手牌中所有的【杀】和伤害类锦囊牌（若其没有【杀】和伤害类锦囊牌则将手牌数弃至与你相同）。若其未因此受到伤害，你对其造成1点火焰伤害。
skills.description_en: Conversion; you may choose its initial state at game start. Once per turn, after Using a card on other characters, choose one target. Yang: draw until your hand size matches theirs, up to five cards, then be treated as Using Fire Attack on them. Yin: have a character with the most hand cards Use all Slashes and damage Tool Cards in their hand on that target; if they have none, they discard down to your hand size. If the target Takes no damage this way, deal 1 fire damage to them.

source_reference.label: Chinese rules reference · Noname
source_reference.note: English translated from this pinned community rules record. The publisher confirms this name in the Shenmo box; compare the Chinese skills with your printed card to confirm its revision. Digital updates can differ from physical printings.

skills.description_cn: 其他角色的出牌阶段开始时，若其手牌数为全场最多，则你可以选择一项：①交给其一张牌，然后摸两张牌；②弃置其一张牌，然后视为对其使用一张【杀】。
skills.description_en: At the start of another character's Play Phase, if their hand size is the highest, you may choose: give them one card and draw two; or discard one of their cards and be treated as Using Slash on them.

skills.description_cn: 结束阶段，你可以获得本回合进入弃牌堆的所有未造成过伤害的伤害牌，然后你可以将这些牌任意分配给其他角色。
skills.description_en: During your End Phase, you may gain all damage cards that entered the discard pile this turn without dealing damage, then distribute any of them among other characters.

source_reference.label: Chinese rules reference · Noname
source_reference.note: English translated from this pinned community rules record. The publisher confirms this name in the Shenmo box; compare the Chinese skills with your printed card to confirm its revision. Digital updates can differ from physical printings.

skills.description_cn: 限定技，一名角色的回合结束时，若一号位体力全场最低，你可令一名角色执行一个额外回合。本回合除你与该角色外，其余角色非锁定技失效；本回合结束后，你获得并分配当前回合所有不因弃置而进入弃牌堆的牌。
skills.description_en: Limited. At the end of a character's turn, if seat 1 has the lowest HP Value, you may have one character take an extra turn. During it, all characters except you and that character have their non-compulsory skills disabled. After it ends, gain and distribute all cards that entered the discard pile during it other than by discarding.

skills.description_cn: 转换技，游戏开始可自选阴阳状态，出牌阶段限一次，你可令一名{阳：手牌数全场最低的角色；阴：手牌数全场最高的角色}将手牌调整至体力上限（至多摸五张）并视为使用一张仅指定单目标的普通锦囊牌（此牌牌名与目标由你指定）。若以此法摸牌，此牌可额外增加一个目标；若以此法弃牌，此牌额外结算一次。
skills.description_en: Conversion; choose the initial state at game start. Once per Play Phase, you may have a character with the fewest hand cards in Yang, or the most in Yin, adjust their hand size to their Max HP, drawing at most five. They are then treated as Using a Non-Time-Delayed Tool Card with exactly one target; you choose its name and target. If they drew cards, it may have one extra target. If they discarded cards, it resolves one additional time.

source_reference.label: Chinese rules reference · Noname
source_reference.note: English translated from this pinned community rules record. The publisher confirms this name in the Shenmo box; compare the Chinese skills with your printed card to confirm its revision. Digital updates can differ from physical printings.

skills.description_cn: 结束阶段结束时，若你本回合使用过牌且这些牌的牌名均不同，你可以观看位于弃牌堆中的这些牌，选择任意张牌并选择等量角色，将这些牌交给这些角色各一张，然后你摸X张牌（X为其中此前未因此给出过的牌名数）。
skills.description_en: At the end of your End Phase, if you Used cards this turn and all their names differ, you may inspect those cards in the discard pile, select any number, and give one each to that many characters. Then draw X cards, where X is the number of names you have never given out this way before.

skills.description_cn: 觉醒技。回合结束时，若你因〖集筹〗给出的牌的牌名总数大于5，你加1点体力上限并回复1点体力，然后获得〖自缚〗。
skills.description_en: Awakening. At turn end, if you have given out more than five different card names through Gather Resources, increase your Max HP by 1, recover 1 HP, and gain Self-Binding.

skills.description_cn: 锁定技。出牌阶段开始时，你将手牌摸至体力上限（至多摸至五张）。若你以此法得到牌，你须选择手牌中不同牌名的牌各一张，然后弃置其余的手牌。
skills.description_en: Compulsory. At the start of your Play Phase, draw until your hand size reaches your Max HP, capped at five cards in hand. If you gain cards this way, you must keep one card of each name in your hand and discard all remaining hand cards.

source_reference.label: Chinese rules reference · Noname
source_reference.note: English translated from this pinned community rules record. The publisher confirms this name in the Shenmo box; compare the Chinese skills with your printed card to confirm its revision. Digital updates can differ from physical printings.

skills.description_cn: 转换技。①游戏开始时，你可以转换此技能状态；②出牌阶段每名角色限一次，你可以令一名攻击范围内的其他角色交给你一张牌。阳：当你于本阶段内下次对其造成伤害时，取消之；阴：当你于本阶段内下次对其造成伤害后，你可以选择除其外的至多三名其他角色，对这些角色依次造成1点伤害。
skills.description_en: Conversion; you may choose its initial state at game start. Once per other character each Play Phase, you may have a character within your Attack Range give you one card. Yang: cancel the next damage you would deal to them this phase. Yin: after you next damage them this phase, you may deal 1 damage each, in order, to up to three different other characters.

skills.description_cn: 锁定技。当你声明使用【杀】时，你令此【杀】的目标对其他角色不可见，且你令攻击范围内的其他角色依次选择是否打出一张红色基本牌。所有角色选择完成后，此牌的目标角色中没有以此法打出牌的角色本回合内无法使用或打出手牌；若有不为此牌目标的角色以此法打出了牌，则你摸两张牌，且你本阶段使用【杀】的次数上限+1。
skills.description_en: Compulsory. When you declare Slash, hide its targets from other characters and have other characters within your Attack Range choose in order whether to Play a red Basic Card. After all choices, targets who did not Play one cannot Use or Play hand cards this turn. If any non-target Played one, draw two cards and increase your Slash limit this phase by 1.

source_reference.label: Chinese rules reference · Noname
source_reference.note: English translated from this pinned community rules record. The publisher confirms this name in the Shenmo box; compare the Chinese skills with your printed card to confirm its revision. Digital updates can differ from physical printings.

skills.description_cn: 锁定技。①游戏开始时，你令系统将牌堆中每个点数的随机一张牌永久标记为“死士”（“死士”对你可见）。②一名角色的回合结束时，若本回合有“死士”不因你使用或打出而进入弃牌堆，你于弃牌堆中获得这些牌。③你使用“死士”不能被响应。
skills.description_en: Compulsory. At game start, permanently mark one random card of each rank in the deck as an Agent, visible to you. At every turn's end, gain Agents from the discard pile that entered it this turn other than through your Use or Play. Agents you Use cannot be responded to.

skills.description_cn: 每回合每名角色限一次。当你使用牌指定第一个目标后，若目标角色包含其他角色，或当其他角色使用牌指定你为目标后，你可以选择手牌数大于你的其中一个目标或此牌的使用者，然后对其造成1点伤害。
skills.description_en: Once per character each turn. After your card designates its first target, if it targets another character, or after another character targets you with a card, you may choose one of those targets or that user with more hand cards than you and deal 1 damage to them.

skills.description_cn: 限定技。出牌阶段，你可以将牌堆、弃牌堆、场上及其他角色的手牌区里的所有“死士”置入处理区，然后你获得这些牌。若如此做，你获得如下效果：1.此阶段结束时，你将这些牌移出游戏；2.当你死亡时，你将所有以此法移出游戏的“死士”置入弃牌堆。
skills.description_en: Limited. During your Play Phase, you may move all Agents from the deck, discard pile, field, and other characters' hands into the Processing Zone, then gain them. At this phase's end, remove those cards from the game. When you die, return all Agents removed this way to the discard pile.

source_reference.label: Chinese rules reference · Noname
source_reference.note: English translated from this pinned community rules record. The publisher confirms this name in the Shenmo box; compare the Chinese skills with your printed card to confirm its revision. Digital updates can differ from physical printings.

skills.description_cn: 锁定技，①你造成伤害后，令你以下数值各+1（至多+3）：1.摸牌阶段摸牌数；2.出牌阶段使用【杀】的次数；3.手牌上限，4.攻击范围。②若你〖横野①〗中任意项已+3，你的回合开始时，你回复1点体力。③你杀死一名角色后，重置此技能。
skills.description_en: Compulsory. After you deal damage, increase each of these by 1, to a maximum bonus of 3: Draw Phase draw count, Play Phase Slash limit, Hand Limit, and Attack Range. If any bonus reaches 3, recover 1 HP at the start of your turn. After you kill a character, reset this skill.

skills.description_cn: 你使用伤害牌时，若此牌本轮已有角色使用过同名牌，此牌造成的伤害改为火焰伤害且伤害+1；否则此牌不可被响应且结算结束后你可将其交给一名其他角色。
skills.description_en: When you Use a damage card, if any character has already Used that name this round, its damage becomes fire damage and increases by 1. Otherwise, it cannot be responded to, and after resolution you may give it to another character.

skills.description_en: When your first Basic or Non-Time-Delayed Tool Card of your turn designates targets, you may add one target. That character must add you as a target of the first Basic or Non-Time-Delayed Tool Card they Use next turn.

skills.description_cn: 以你为目标的牌结算结束后，你摸一张牌并选择一项：1.展示一张本回合未展示过的【杀】或普通锦囊牌，视为对使用者使用之；2.再摸三张牌且此技能失效至你的回合开始（若此时在你的回合内，改为失效至你的回合结束）。
skills.description_en: After a card targeting you resolves, draw one card and choose: Show a Slash or Non-Time-Delayed Tool Card you have not Shown this turn and be treated as Using it on the user; or draw three more cards and disable this skill until your turn starts, or until your turn ends if currently your turn.

skills.description_cn: 转换技。①游戏开始时，你可以转换此技能状态；②一张牌结算结束后，若此牌的目标包括你，你可以选择一张手牌，阳：此牌视为无距离次数限制的火【杀】并摸一张牌（你可额外摸一张牌并令此技能本阶段失效）；阴：令你此颜色的当前手牌不计入手牌上限并可横置一名角色（你可额外横置一名角色并令此技能本阶段失效）。
skills.description_en: Conversion; you may choose its initial state at game start. After a card targeting you resolves, you may select a hand card. Yang: it is treated as a Fire Slash with no usage or distance limits, and draw one card; you may draw one more and disable this skill for this phase. Yin: your current hand cards of that color do not count toward your Hand Limit, and you may Turn one character sideways; you may Turn one additional character sideways and disable this skill for this phase.

skills.description_cn: 限定技，出牌阶段，你可选择任意名横置的其他角色并回复等量体力，然后这些角色同时展示一张手牌，你可弃置相同花色牌并对展示对应花色的角色各造成1点火焰伤害，若这些角色均受到伤害则重复此流程， 且此技能结算期间你每失去一张牌则摸一张牌。
skills.description_en: Limited. During your Play Phase, choose any number of sideways other characters and recover that much HP. They simultaneously Show one hand card each. You may discard cards of matching suits to deal 1 fire damage to each character Showing that suit. If all chosen characters Take damage, repeat this process. While resolving this skill, draw one card whenever you lose one card.

skills.description_en: At the end of your Draw Phase, you may draw two cards, then Show three hand cards and have another character gain one of their choice. If your hand size is not the highest, draw two more cards.

skills.description_cn: 转换技。①游戏开始时，你可以转换此技能状态；②每回合每项各限一次，当你得到其他角色的牌后，或其他角色得到你的牌后：阳，你可以令该角色使用至多X张【杀】，且其每以此法造成1点伤害，你与其回复1点体力；阴，你可令该角色打出至多X张【杀】，然后其失去Y点体力。（X为你的体力上限，Y为X-其打出【杀】数）
skills.description_en: Conversion; you may choose its initial state at game start. Each state once per turn, after you gain another character's cards or they gain yours: Yang, you may have them Use up to X Slashes, and whenever those deal 1 damage, you and they each recover 1 HP. Yin, you may have them Play up to X Slashes, then Lose HP equal to X minus the number Played. X is your Max HP.

skills.description_en: Once per Play Phase, you may draw or discard up to three cards, then have all other characters adjust their hand sizes to yours. Those who discarded this way draw three cards; those who drew discard three; those whose hand size did not change take 1 damage from you.

skills.description_cn: 其他角色的回合结束时，若你和当前回合角色都不是手牌数唯一最多的角色，则你可以摸一张牌。
skills.description_en: At the end of another character's turn, if neither you nor that character has the uniquely largest hand, you may draw one card.

skills.description_cn: 主公技，你发动〖斩绊〗时，可以选择任意群雄角色不成为此次技能的目标。
skills.description_en: Lord. When activating Sever Restraints, you may exclude any Qun characters from its targets.

skills.description_en: Once per Play Phase, you may have a character draw three cards and choose: until the end of their next turn, those cards cannot be Used and do not count toward their Hand Limit; or Lose 1 HP, draw one card, Use any of the cards gained through this skill, then discard the rest.

skills.description_cn: 锁定技，当你每回合首次失去的基本牌或普通锦囊牌进入弃牌堆时，你获得其中一张。当你本回合再次失去这张牌后，你弃置一张牌。
skills.description_en: Compulsory. Each turn, when the Basic or Non-Time-Delayed Tool Cards you first lose enter the discard pile, gain one of them. If you lose that card again this turn, discard one card.

skills.description_cn: 一名角色的出牌阶段限一次。其可以交给你一张牌（若其为你则改为选择一张自己装备区的牌获得之或选择一张手牌），你可以使用此牌，然后其本回合攻击范围+X（X为你装备区里的牌数）。若此牌为装备牌或此牌造成了伤害，你与其各摸两张牌。
skills.description_en: Once during each character's Play Phase, they may give you one card. If that character is you, instead gain a card from your Equipment Zone or select a hand card. You may Use that card; their Attack Range then increases by your equipped card count for this turn. If it is Equipment or deals damage, you and that character each draw two cards.

skills.description_cn: 当你不因〖应时〗使用普通锦囊牌指定目标后，你可令其中一个目标选择一项：⒈令你于此牌结算结束后视为对其使用一张与此牌牌名相同的牌；⒉弃置X张牌，你本回合不能再发动〖应时〗（X为你装备区里的牌数+1）。
skills.description_en: After you designate targets for a Non-Time-Delayed Tool Card not Used through this skill, you may have one target choose: after resolution, you are treated as Using the same card name on them again; or they discard X cards and you cannot activate Timely Response again this turn. X is your equipped card count plus 1.

skills.description_en: Conversion; you may choose its initial state at game start. When you Use a Tool Card, you may: Yang, deal 1 damage to yourself and draw cards equal to your lost HP; Yin, have one character discard another's card and take 1 damage from that other character. If this skill puts you into a Dying Event, recover to 1 HP.

skills.description_cn: 限定技，当有角色脱离濒死状态时，你可以回复所有体力，然后修改〖绝谋〗。
skills.description_en: Limited. When a character leaves a Dying Event, you may recover all your HP, then upgrade Absolute Scheme.

skills.description_cn: 转换技。①游戏开始时，你可以转换此技能状态；②当你使用锦囊牌时，或回合开始/结束时，你可以：阳：对自己造成1点伤害并摸已损失体力值数张牌；阴：令一名角色弃置另一名角色一张牌并受到其造成的1点伤害。若你因此技能进入濒死，你将体力值回复至1点。
skills.description_en: Conversion; you may choose its initial state at game start. When you Use a Tool Card, or at the start or end of a turn, you may: Yang, deal 1 damage to yourself and draw cards equal to your lost HP; Yin, have one character discard another's card and take 1 damage from that other character. If this puts you into a Dying Event, recover to 1 HP.

skills.description_en: Limited. During your Play Phase, you may record your current Overturning Scheme state, hand size, and HP Value, then gain Enter the World.

skills.description_cn: 转换技。①游戏开始时，你可以转换此技能状态；②出牌阶段限一次，你可以观看一名其他角色A的手牌并展示其至多一半手牌：阳，并将这些牌交给另一名其他角色B，然后你与A各摸X张牌（X为A以此法失去的手牌数）；阴，令A依次使用这些牌中所有其可以使用的牌（无距离限制且不可被响应）。
skills.description_en: Conversion; you may choose its initial state at game start. Once per Play Phase, you may look at another character A's hand and Show up to half of it. Yang: give those cards to another character B, then you and A each draw cards equal to A's lost hand cards. Yin: have A Use, in order, all Shown cards they can Use, with no distance limit and no responses allowed.

skills.description_cn: 限定技，出牌阶段，你可以将你当前〖覆谋〗的状态、你的手牌数和你的体力值调整为你发动〖肃身〗时的记录，然后重置〖覆谋〗的发动次数。
skills.description_en: Limited. During your Play Phase, you may restore your Overturning Scheme state, hand size, and HP Value to the record made by Discipline Oneself, then reset Overturning Scheme's activation count.

skills.description_en: Once per turn, after you target another character with a card, or after another character targets you, you may give up to two cards to another character. In the first case, the card resolves one additional time; in the second, it is Nullified.

skills.description_cn: 锁定技，你交给其他角色牌后，该角色须交给你等量张牌（无法选择你本回合交给其的牌），否则你摸等量张牌。

skills.description_en: After you Use a Tool Card, you may increase the damage of all damage cards currently in your hand by 1 until this turn ends.

skills.description_cn: 出牌阶段限一次，你可以亮出牌堆顶的一张牌，然后若此牌：为【杀】，你使用此牌；不为【杀】，你选择一项：①获得所有亮出的牌；②若亮出的牌数小于存活角色数，重复此流程。
skills.description_en: Once per Play Phase, you may Reveal the top card of the deck. If it is Slash, Use it. Otherwise, choose: gain all Revealed cards; or, if the number Revealed is below the number of living characters, repeat this process.

skills.description_cn: ①每轮开始时，你可以交给一名角色一张牌，称为“舆”。②当“舆”因使用进入弃牌堆时，你可以将之交给本轮未获得过“舆”的一名角色，称为“舆”。③每轮结束时，你弃置所有“舆”，然后可以令本轮所有获得过“舆”的角色依次视为对你指定的一名角色使用一张无距离限制的【杀】。
skills.description_en: At the start of each round, you may give one character a card marked as Carriage. When Carriage enters the discard pile through Use, you may give it to a character who has not received Carriage this round, keeping its mark. At round end, discard all Carriage cards. You may have all characters who received one this round, in order, be treated as Using a Slash with no distance limit on one character you choose.

skills.description_cn: 其他角色的出牌阶段开始时，若其手牌数为全场最多，你可以将所有手牌交给其，直到本回合结束，当其造成伤害后，你摸一张牌。
skills.description_en: At the start of another character's Play Phase, if they have the most hand cards, you may give them your entire hand. Until this turn ends, draw one card after they deal damage.

skills.description_cn: 出牌阶段限一次，你可以选择一名其他角色并展示其一张手牌。该角色弃置手牌中所有与此牌花色相同的牌，然后你视为对其使用X张【杀】 （X为该角色手牌和装备区里与此牌类别相同的牌数）。若其没有因此受到伤害，你将手牌摸至体力上限。此阶段结束时，若其手牌数和体力值均小于等于你，其装备区里的牌失效至其下回合结束且下回合摸牌阶段摸牌数减一。
skills.description_en: Once per Play Phase, choose another character and Show one of their hand cards. They discard all hand cards of that suit. You are then treated as Using X Slashes on them, where X is the count of cards of that type in their hand and Equipment Zone. If they Take no damage this way, draw up to your Max HP. At phase end, if both their hand size and HP Value are at most yours, their equipped cards are Nullified until their next turn ends, and they draw one fewer card in their next Draw Phase.

skills.description_en: Conversion; you may choose its initial state at game start. At the end of a turn in which you lost cards, Yang: look at the top five cards and gain up to X; if you gain fewer than X, gain Bequeathed Plan until you next activate this state. Yin: look at a character's hand and discard up to X cards from it; if you discard X, make a Lightning judgment. X is the number of cards you lost this turn.

skills.description_cn: 其他角色对其以外的角色使用普通锦囊牌的结算中，若你手牌中两种颜色的牌数量相同，你可将一张手牌当作不可被响应的【无懈可击】使用。
skills.description_en: While another character's Non-Time-Delayed Tool Card targeting someone else resolves, if your hand contains equal numbers of red and black cards, you may Use a hand card as an unrespondable Negate.

skills.description_cn: 当你受到1点伤害后，你可以观看牌堆顶的两张牌，然后将其分配给任意角色。
skills.description_en: After each 1 damage you Take, you may look at the top two cards of the deck and distribute them among any characters.

skills.description_en: Once per Play Phase, you may Use all hand cards of one color as Slash with no distance or usage limit. Before Using it, choose X options, where X is the number of card types used in the conversion: draw one card; disable the target's non-compulsory skills this turn; increase this skill's activation limit this turn by 1. If you choose all options, the Slash's damage increases by 1.

skills.description_en: Once per Play Phase, you may draw up to your Max HP and Pindian X times, where X is the number of cards drawn. For each win, you are treated as Using Slash on all other characters who have not won a Pindian this turn. For each non-win, your opponent is treated as Using Slash on you.

skills.description_cn: 锁定技，回合开始时，你将体力值回复至体力上限，然后于此回合结束时失去等量点体力（至多失去至1点）。
skills.description_en: Compulsory. At the start of your turn, recover to your Max HP. At this turn's end, Lose that much HP, but not below 1 HP.

skills.description_cn: 出牌阶段限一次，你弃置所有当前无法指定其他角色为目标的手牌，并根据弃牌数依次选择等量项：1.本回合计算与其他角色距离-X；2.视为对至多X名角色使用【顺手牵羊】；3.视为对至多X名角色使用【杀】。若你执行了所有选项，此技能视为未发动过（X为此项被选择的次序）。
skills.description_en: Once per Play Phase, discard all hand cards that currently cannot target another character, then choose that many options in order: reduce your Distance to other characters by X this turn; be treated as Using Steal on up to X characters; or be treated as Using Slash on up to X characters. X is the position in which the option was chosen. If you perform all options, reset this skill's activation count.

skills.description_cn: 限定技，出牌阶段，若你本回合造成过伤害，你可以摸两张牌，且直到你的下个回合开始前，你受到伤害时防止之并摸一张牌。你的下个回合开始时，弃置所有【杀】和锦囊牌并失去等量体力，若你未因此失去体力，此技能视为未发动过。
skills.description_en: Limited. During your Play Phase, if you dealt damage this turn, you may draw two cards. Until your next turn starts, prevent damage you would Take and draw one card instead. At your next turn's start, discard all Slashes and Tool Cards and Lose that much HP. If you Lose no HP this way, reset this skill.

skills.description_cn: 每回合限一次，有角色体力变化后，你可观看牌堆顶三张牌并选择其中一张牌获得并秘密记录此牌名，直至本轮结束该牌名牌被使用时移除记录牌名，你可令此牌无效。
skills.description_en: Once per turn, after any character's HP changes, you may look at the top three cards, gain one, and secretly record its name. Until round end, when a card with that name is Used, remove the record and you may Nullify that card.

skills.description_cn: 出牌阶段限一次，你可令一名角色亮出牌堆顶一张牌，若为伤害牌其受到X点火焰伤害，若不为伤害牌，其选择一项执行：1、获得此牌并再次亮牌（次数不能超过存活人数）；2、直至其回合结束其攻击范围-X。（X为因此亮出的牌数）
skills.description_en: Once per Play Phase, have a character Reveal the top card. If it is a damage card, they take X fire damage. Otherwise, they choose: gain it and Reveal again, up to the number of living characters; or reduce their Attack Range by X until their turn ends. X is the number of cards Revealed this way.

source_reference.label: Chinese rules reference · Noname
source_reference.note: English translated from this pinned community rules record. The publisher confirms this name in the Shenmo box; compare the Chinese skills with your printed card to confirm its revision. Digital updates can differ from physical printings.

skills.description_cn: 出牌阶段限一次，你令所有其他角色同时选择是否交给你一张牌，你以此法获得的牌不计入手牌上限，未交给你牌的角色，本回合你对其下次造成伤害+1；然后你令最快交给你牌的角色选择另一名其他角色，你对该角色发动一次〖撰文〗。
skills.description_en: Once per Play Phase, have all other characters simultaneously choose whether to give you one card. Cards gained this way do not count toward your Hand Limit. Your next damage this turn to a character who gave no card increases by 1. Have the fastest contributor choose a different character, and activate Compose a Work on that character.

skills.description_cn: 结束阶段，你可展示牌堆顶X张牌并选择一项对一名角色执行：1.对其使用其中的伤害牌；2.令其获得其中的非伤害牌。然后将剩余牌置于牌堆顶（X为你的手牌数且至多为5）。
skills.description_en: During your End Phase, you may Show the top X cards and choose one effect for a character: Use the damage cards on them; or have them gain the non-damage cards. Return the remaining cards to the top of the deck. X is your hand size, capped at 5.

source_reference.label: Chinese rules reference · Noname
source_reference.note: English translated from this pinned community rules record. The publisher confirms this name in the Shenmo box; compare the Chinese skills with your printed card to confirm its revision. Digital updates can differ from physical printings.

skills.description_cn: 锁定技。①当你于出牌阶段使用牌时，你选择此阶段未执行过的一项执行：⒈令一名其他角色弃置X张牌；⒉摸X张牌；⒊重铸X张牌；⒋弃置X张牌（X为此技能于本阶段的发动次数）。②出牌阶段结束时，若你本阶段执行过〖渐专①〗的所有选项且〖渐专①〗剩余选项数大于1，则你随机移除〖渐专①〗的一项。
skills.description_en: Compulsory. Whenever you Use a card during your Play Phase, perform an option not chosen this phase: have another character discard X cards; draw X cards; Recast X cards; or discard X cards. X is this skill's activation count this phase. At phase end, if you performed every remaining option and more than one remains, randomly remove one option.

skills.description_cn: 觉醒技，结束阶段，若〖渐专①〗剩余选项数小于2，则你执行三次X视为1的剩余选项，然后增加2点体力上限并回复2点体力，失去〖渐专〗并获得〖覆斗〗。
skills.description_en: Awakening. During your End Phase, if fewer than two options remain in Growing Autocracy, perform the remaining option three times with X equal to 1. Increase your Max HP by 2, recover 2 HP, lose Growing Autocracy, and gain Overturning Duel.

skills.description_cn: 当你使用黑色牌/红色牌指定唯一目标后，若该角色不为你，且其于本局游戏对你/未对你造成过伤害，则你可以与其各失去1点体力/各摸一张牌。
skills.description_en: After your black card targets exactly one other character who has damaged you this game, you may have both of you Lose 1 HP. After your red card targets exactly one other character who has not damaged you this game, you may have both of you draw one card.

source_reference.label: Chinese rules reference · Noname
source_reference.note: English translated from this pinned community rules record. The publisher confirms this name in the Shenmo box; compare the Chinese skills with your printed card to confirm its revision. Digital updates can differ from physical printings.

skills.description_cn: 锁定技，每回合限一次，一名角色失去装备区的牌后，你摸等同于其装备区空缺装备栏数的牌。
skills.description_en: Compulsory; once per turn. After a character loses cards from their Equipment Zone, draw cards equal to their empty equipment slots.

skills.description_cn: 锁定技，结束阶段，你弃置装备区里的所有牌。若你以此法弃置了牌，选择弃牌堆里的一张伤害牌并令一名其他角色使用之（此牌对你造成的伤害视为无来源）。
skills.description_en: Compulsory. During your End Phase, discard all cards in your Equipment Zone. If you discard any, choose a damage card in the discard pile and have another character Use it. Damage it deals to you is treated as having no source.

source_reference.label: Chinese rules reference · Noname
source_reference.note: English translated from this pinned community rules record. The publisher confirms this name in the Shenmo box; compare the Chinese skills with your printed card to confirm its revision. Digital updates can differ from physical printings.

skills.description_cn: ①当你于一名角色的出牌阶段第一次造成伤害后，你可以摸X张牌（X为本回合你已使用的牌数）。②你的结束阶段，若你本回合没有造成伤害，你可以对两名其他角色各造成1点伤害。
skills.description_en: After you first deal damage during a character's Play Phase, you may draw cards equal to the number of cards you have Used this turn. During your End Phase, if you dealt no damage this turn, you may deal 1 damage each to two other characters.

skills.description_cn: 觉醒技。准备阶段，若场上已受伤的角色数大于你的体力值，你加3点体力上限并回复3点体力，失去〖逐寇〗，获得〖玉殒〗。
skills.description_en: Awakening. During your Preparation Phase, if the number of wounded characters exceeds your HP Value, increase your Max HP by 3, recover 3 HP, lose Pursue Raiders, and gain Jade's Fall.

skills.description_cn: 锁定技，出牌阶段开始时，你失去1点体力或体力上限（不能减至1以下），然后选择至多X+1项（X为你已损失的体力值）：①摸两张牌；②对一名其他角色造成1点伤害，然后本回合对其使用【杀】无距离和次数限制；③本回合的手牌上限视为无限；④获得一名其他角色区域内的一张牌；⑤令一名其他角色将手牌摸至体力上限（最多摸至5）。
skills.description_en: Compulsory. At the start of your Play Phase, Lose 1 HP or reduce your Max HP by 1, without reducing Max HP below 1, then choose up to your lost HP plus 1 options: draw two cards; deal 1 damage to another character and have no Slash distance or usage limits against them this turn; have unlimited Hand Limit this turn; gain one card from another character's zones; have another character draw up to their Max HP, capped at five hand cards.

source_reference.label: Chinese rules reference · Noname
source_reference.note: English translated from this pinned community rules record. The publisher confirms this name in the Shenmo box; compare the Chinese skills with your printed card to confirm its revision. Digital updates can differ from physical printings.

skills.description_cn: 出牌阶段限一次，你可以用一张手牌与至多三名角色同时拼点，然后依次结算拼点结果，没赢的角色选择一项：1.弃置一张牌；2.令你摸一张牌。若你没赢，你获得一个“饶舌”标记。当你获得第7个“饶舌”标记时，你死亡。
skills.description_en: Once per Play Phase, you may use one hand card to Pindian simultaneously with up to three characters, then resolve each comparison in order. Each non-winner chooses: discard one card; or have you draw one card. Whenever you do not win, gain one Talk token. When you gain your seventh Talk token, you die.

skills.description_cn: 当你的拼点牌亮出后，若点数不大于X，你可令点数+X并令〖鼓舌〗视为未发动过（X为你的“饶舌”标记数）。
skills.description_en: After your Pindian card is Revealed, if its rank is at most your Talk token count, you may increase its rank by that count and reset Silver Tongue's activation count.

source_reference.label: Chinese rules reference · Noname
source_reference.note: English translated from this pinned community rules record. The publisher confirms this name in the Shenmo box; compare the Chinese skills with your printed card to confirm its revision. Digital updates can differ from physical printings.

skills.description_cn: 锁定技。一名角色于一轮内首次造成伤害后，你摸一张牌。若此时是该角色回合外，则改为摸X张牌（X为本回合全场造成的伤害值）。
skills.description_en: Compulsory. After each character first deals damage in a round, draw one card. If it is outside that character's turn, instead draw cards equal to all damage dealt this turn.

skills.description_cn: 出牌阶段，你可以选择一名本回合内未造成过伤害的其他角色。你本阶段内使用的下一张牌改为以该角色为基准判断使用目标合法性，且使用者改为该角色。
skills.description_en: During your Play Phase, you may choose another character who has dealt no damage this turn. The next card you Use this phase checks target legality from their perspective and has them as its user instead.

source_reference.label: Chinese rules reference · Noname
source_reference.note: English translated from this pinned community rules record. The publisher confirms this name in the Shenmo box; compare the Chinese skills with your printed card to confirm its revision. Digital updates can differ from physical printings.

skills.description_cn: 锁定技。①游戏开始时，你记录一个花色。②每回合〖异瞳〗记录花色的牌首次因使用而进入弃牌堆后，你从牌堆或弃牌堆获得与此花色不同的牌各一张。
skills.description_en: Compulsory. At game start, record one suit. The first time each turn a card of that suit enters the discard pile through Use, gain one card of each other suit from the deck or discard pile.

skills.description_cn: ①你可以将〖异瞳〗记录花色的牌当作【酒】使用（无任何次数限制）。②其他角色进入濒死状态时，你可以对其使用【酒】（回复效果）。
skills.description_en: You may Use cards of the suit recorded by Different-Colored Eyes as Wine with no usage limits. When another character enters a Dying Event, you may Use Wine on them for its recovery effect.

source_reference.label: Chinese rules reference · Noname
source_reference.note: English translated from this pinned community rules record. The publisher confirms this name in the Shenmo box; compare the Chinese skills with your printed card to confirm its revision. Digital updates can differ from physical printings.

skills.description_cn: 锁定技。①游戏开始时，你令所有存活且未拥有转换技的角色获得〖手谈〗。②你发动〖手谈〗时无需弃置牌，且无次数限制。③所有拥有转换技的角色不能使用牌指定其他拥有转换技且双方所有转换技状态均相同的角色为目标。
skills.description_en: Compulsory. At game start, all living characters without Conversion skills gain Silent Game. Your Silent Game requires no discard and has no usage limit. Characters with Conversion skills cannot target other characters with Conversion skills when all Conversion states on both characters are the same.

skills.description_cn: 转换技。出牌阶段限一次，阳：你可以弃置一张不为黑色的手牌。阴：你可以弃置一张黑色手牌。
skills.description_en: Conversion. Once per Play Phase, Yang: you may discard a non-black hand card; Yin: you may discard a black hand card.

skills.description_cn: ①准备阶段，你可以从弃牌堆中选择获得至多X张不因使用而进入弃牌堆的牌。②结束阶段，若你的手牌区中没有因〖复学①〗得到的牌，则你摸X张牌（X为你的体力值）。
skills.description_en: During your Preparation Phase, you may gain up to X cards from the discard pile that entered it other than through Use. During your End Phase, if none of those cards remain in your hand, draw X cards. X is your HP Value.

source_reference.label: Chinese rules reference · Noname
source_reference.note: English translated from this pinned community rules record. The publisher confirms this name in the Shenmo box; compare the Chinese skills with your printed card to confirm its revision. Digital updates can differ from physical printings.

skills.description_cn: 准备阶段，你可以选择一项：1.回复1点体力；2.受到你造成的1点伤害。然后你令任意名角色执行该项。若如此做，这些角色于结束阶段执行另一项。
skills.description_en: During your Preparation Phase, you may choose: recover 1 HP; or take 1 damage from yourself. Have any number of characters perform the same option. If you do, those characters perform the opposite option during your End Phase.

skills.description_cn: 当你使用对应实体牌均为你的手牌的【杀】或锦囊牌结算结束后，若此牌目标为1，你可以视为对该目标使用一张无伤害来源的【杀】。然后若你本回合发动〖寅君〗的次数大于你的体力值，〖寅君〗失效直到回合结束。
skills.description_en: After a Slash or Tool Card you Use resolves, if all its physical cards came from your hand and it had one target, you may be treated as Using a Slash with no damage source on that target. If your activations of this skill this turn exceed your HP Value, disable it until turn end.

source_reference.label: Chinese rules reference · Noname
source_reference.note: English translated from this pinned community rules record. The publisher confirms this name in the Shenmo box; compare the Chinese skills with your printed card to confirm its revision. Digital updates can differ from physical printings.

skills.description_cn: 当你使用【杀】指定唯一目标后，你可以与其拼点。若你赢，此【杀】结算结束后，你可以对另一名其他角色造成1点伤害。
skills.description_en: After your Slash designates a sole target, you may Pindian with them. If you win, after the Slash resolves, you may deal 1 damage to a different other character.

skills.description_cn: 锁定技。①【南蛮入侵】对你无效。②当其他角色使用【南蛮入侵】结算结束后，你获得此牌对应的所有实体牌。③结束阶段，若你未于本回合使用过【南蛮入侵】，你将一张游戏外的随机【南蛮入侵】（共两张）交给一名角色。
skills.description_en: Compulsory. Barbarian Invasion is Nullified against you. After another character's Barbarian Invasion resolves, gain all its physical cards. During your End Phase, if you did not Use Barbarian Invasion this turn, give one character a random Barbarian Invasion from outside the game; two are available in total.

source_reference.label: Chinese rules reference · Noname
source_reference.note: English translated from this pinned community rules record. The publisher confirms this name in the Shenmo box; compare the Chinese skills with your printed card to confirm its revision. Digital updates can differ from physical printings.

skills.description_cn: 锁定技。①游戏开始时，你将手牌摸至七张。②准备阶段，你将体力值回复或失去至等同于牌堆中点数为7的牌数（你的体力值最低因此调整至1）。然后你观看牌堆顶X张牌，将这些牌以任意顺序置于牌堆顶或牌堆底（X为你的体力值）。
skills.description_en: Compulsory. At game start, draw until you have seven hand cards. During your Preparation Phase, recover or Lose HP until your HP Value equals the number of rank-7 cards in the deck, with a minimum of 1. Then look at the top X cards and place them in any order on top or bottom of the deck, where X is your HP Value.

skills.description_cn: 当你于出牌阶段使用牌时，若你手牌中有同名牌且你本回合未因此牌名的牌发动过该技能，你可以选择一项：1.令此牌对其中一个目标角色造成的伤害+1；2.令任意名其他角色各摸一张牌；3.摸三张牌，然后〖情势〗于本回合无效。
skills.description_en: When you Use a card during your Play Phase, if you hold another card of that name and have not activated this skill for that name this turn, you may choose: increase its damage to one target by 1; have any number of other characters each draw one card; or draw three cards and disable this skill this turn.

skills.description_cn: 限定技。出牌阶段，你可以选择一张手牌并复制之。当你使用或打出此复制牌结算结束后，你获得之，然后你本回合不能再使用或打出此牌。
skills.description_en: Limited. During your Play Phase, you may select and copy one hand card. After your Use or Play of the copy resolves, regain it, then you cannot Use or Play it again this turn.

source_reference.label: Chinese rules reference · Noname
source_reference.note: English translated from this pinned community rules record. The publisher confirms this name in the Shenmo box; compare the Chinese skills with your printed card to confirm its revision. Digital updates can differ from physical printings.

skills.description_cn: 使命技。①使命：出牌阶段限一次。你可以对一名其他角色造成1点火焰伤害，然后你对所有与其势力相同的不为其的其他角色各造成1点火焰伤害。②成功：准备阶段，若你本局游戏已对其他角色造成的火焰伤害不小于本局游戏总角色数，则你失去〖火计〗和〖看破〗，然后获得〖观星〗和〖空城〗。③失败：使命成功前进入濒死状态。
skills.description_en: Mission. Once per Play Phase, deal 1 fire damage to another character, then 1 fire damage each to all other characters of that faction except that target. Success: during your Preparation Phase, if your total fire damage to other characters this game is at least the game's total character count, lose Fire Stratagem and See Through, then gain Stargazing and Empty City. Failure: enter a Dying Event before succeeding.

skills.description_cn: ①每轮开始时，你清除〖看破①〗记录的牌名，然后你可以依次记录任意个未于上次发动〖看破①〗记录清除过的非装备牌牌名（对其他角色不可见，每局游戏至多记录2个牌名）。②其他角色使用你〖看破①〗记录过的牌名的牌时，你可以移去一个〖看破①〗中的此牌名的记录令此牌无效，然后你摸一张牌。
skills.description_en: At the start of each round, clear this skill's recorded names, then you may secretly record non-Equipment card names not cleared at the previous activation, with at most two names recorded over the entire game. When another character Uses a recorded name, you may remove that record to Nullify the card, then draw one card.

skills.description_cn: ①准备阶段，你将所有“星”置入弃牌堆，将牌堆顶的X张牌置于你的武将牌上，称为“星”（X为7-此前发动〖观星①〗次数的三倍，且X至少为0）。然后你可以将任意张“星”置于牌堆顶。②结束阶段，若你未于本回合的准备阶段将“星”置于过牌堆顶，你可以将任意张“星”置于牌堆顶。③你可以如手牌般使用或打出“星”。
skills.description_en: During your Preparation Phase, put all Stars into the discard pile and put the top X cards on your General Card as Stars, where X is 7 minus three times the number of previous activations of this effect, minimum 0. You may put any Stars on top of the deck. During your End Phase, if you put no Stars on top during this turn's Preparation Phase, you may do so now. You may Use or Play Stars as hand cards.

skills.description_cn: 锁定技。当你受到伤害时，若你拥有技能〖观星〗，且若你：有“星”，你判定，若结果点数不大于你的“星”数，此伤害-1；没有“星”，此伤害+1。
skills.description_en: Compulsory. When you Take damage, if you have Stargazing: with Stars, make a judgment and reduce damage by 1 if its rank is at most your Star count; without Stars, increase damage by 1.

source_reference.label: Chinese rules reference · Noname
source_reference.note: English translated from this pinned community rules record. The publisher confirms this name in the Shenmo box; compare the Chinese skills with your printed card to confirm its revision. Digital updates can differ from physical printings.

skills.description_cn: 一名角色的判定牌生效前，你可以观看牌堆顶的一张牌，然后可以用此牌代替之或用一张手牌替换之。
skills.description_en: Before a character's judgment card takes effect, you may look at the top card of the deck, then Substitute it for the judgment card, or Replace and keep the judgment card using a hand card.

skills.description_cn: 蓄力技（1/3）。你一次性获得至少两张牌时，可以消耗1点蓄力值并令至多两名角色各摸一张牌；一名其他角色一次性失去至少两张牌时，你可以消耗1点蓄力值令其摸两张牌。
skills.description_en: Charge (1/3). When you gain at least two cards at once, you may spend 1 Charge to have up to two characters each draw one card. When another character loses at least two cards at once, you may spend 1 Charge to have them draw two cards.

skills.description_cn: 锁定技，每轮限两次，你于回合外失去牌时，你选择一名角色：若其有蓄力技，其获得1点蓄力值；若你失去的牌中有非基本牌，其摸两张牌。
skills.description_en: Compulsory; twice per round. When you lose cards outside your turn, choose a character. If they have a Charge skill, they gain 1 Charge. If your lost cards include a non-Basic Card, they draw two cards.

source_reference.label: Chinese rules reference · Noname
source_reference.note: English translated from this pinned community rules record. The publisher confirms this name in the Shenmo box; compare the Chinese skills with your printed card to confirm its revision. Digital updates can differ from physical printings.

skills.description_cn: 锁定技。摸牌阶段，你多摸X张牌，且令你本回合手牌上限+X（X为以下条件中你满足的项数：手牌数不小于2、体力值不小于2、装备区里的牌数不小于1）。
skills.description_en: Compulsory. During your Draw Phase, draw X additional cards and increase your Hand Limit by X this turn. X is the number of conditions met: at least two hand cards; at least 2 HP; at least one equipped card.

skills.description_cn: 出牌阶段，你可以声明一个花色并选择一张手牌和一名其他角色（每种花色的牌每回合限一次）。其须选择一项：1.猜测此牌花色与你所声明花色是否相同；2.翻面。然后其正面向上获得此牌。若其选择猜测且猜测错误，其失去1点体力，否则其令你〖反间〗于本回合失效。
skills.description_en: During your Play Phase, declare a suit and choose one hand card and another character, each actual card suit once per turn. They must choose: guess whether its suit matches your declaration; or Flip their General Card. Then they gain the card face up. If they guessed incorrectly, they Lose 1 HP; otherwise, they disable Sow Discord for this turn.

skills.description_cn: 准备阶段，你可以选择一名角色。从其开始按逆时针方向的X名其他角色依次执行（X为角色数的一半，向上取整）：展示一张手牌，若此牌为黑色，你获得之且此牌不计入本回合手牌上限；若此牌为红色，其弃置之。
skills.description_en: During your Preparation Phase, choose a character. Starting there and proceeding counterclockwise, X other characters each Show one hand card, where X is half the character count rounded up. Gain black cards Shown this way; they do not count toward your Hand Limit this turn. Red cards are discarded by their holders.

skills.description_cn: 你可以将一张黑色手牌当做【闪】使用或打出。
skills.description_en: You may Use or Play a black hand card as Dodge.

skills.description_cn: 蓄力技（1/3）。①你可以消耗1点蓄力值，将【杀】当做【闪】或将【闪】当做【杀】使用或打出，然后你摸一张牌。②一名角色的回合结束时，你获得1点蓄力值。
skills.description_en: Charge (1/3). You may spend 1 Charge to Use or Play Slash as Dodge, or Dodge as Slash, then draw one card. At the end of every character's turn, gain 1 Charge.

skills.description_cn: 准备阶段开始时，你可以和一名其他角色进行〖协力〗。其的下个结束阶段开始时，若你与其协力成功，则你修改〖龙胆〗为〖龙胆·改〗直到你的下个回合结束后。
skills.description_en: At the start of your Preparation Phase, you may establish Cooperation with another character. At the start of their next End Phase, if Cooperation succeeded, upgrade Dragon Courage until after your next turn ends.

skills.description_cn: 蓄力技（1/3）。①你可以消耗1点蓄力值，将一张基本牌当做任意基本牌使用或打出，然后摸一张牌。②一名角色的回合结束时，你获得1点蓄力值。
skills.description_en: Charge (1/3). You may spend 1 Charge to Use or Play a Basic Card as any Basic Card, then draw one card. At the end of every character's turn, gain 1 Charge.

skills.description_cn: 你的回合限两次，当你不因此技能获得牌后，你可以将其中任意张牌置入弃牌堆，然后获得至多X名其他角色各一张手牌（X为你以此法置入弃牌堆的牌数）。
skills.description_en: Twice during your turn, after you gain cards other than through this skill, you may put any of them into the discard pile, then gain one hand card each from up to that many other characters.

skills.description_cn: 准备阶段，你可以选择一名其他角色并选择一项：①令其获得其装备区的至多两张牌。②你获得牌堆中的一张【杀】。③〖背水〗：你失去1点体力。
skills.description_en: During your Preparation Phase, choose another character and an option: they gain up to two cards from their Equipment Zone; or you gain a Slash from the deck. Backwater: Lose 1 HP to perform both options.

skills.description_cn: 出牌阶段，你可以选择一名其他角色并弃4枚“道兵”，对其造成1点雷电伤害。
skills.description_en: During your Play Phase, you may remove four Dao Soldier tokens to deal 1 thunder damage to another character.

skills.description_cn: ①游戏开始时/一名角色受到属性伤害后，你获得6/2枚“道兵”（标记上限为8）。②当你受到伤害时，你可以弃2枚“道兵”并防止此伤害。然后若当前回合角色不为你，〖鬼道①〗于你下回合开始前无效。
skills.description_en: At game start, gain six Dao Soldiers; after any character Takes elemental damage, gain two, to a maximum of eight. When you Take damage, you may remove two Dao Soldiers to prevent it. If it is not your turn, disable the token-gaining effect until your next turn starts.

skills.description_cn: 主公技，锁定技。①回合开始时，若本回合为你的第一个回合且游戏轮数为1，且游戏内没有【太平要术】，你装备【太平要术】。②其他群势力角色造成伤害后，若你拥有〖鬼道〗，你获得2枚“道兵”（每轮你至多以此法获得4枚“道兵”）。
skills.description_en: Lord; compulsory. At the start of your first turn, if it is round 1 and no Taiping Arts exists in the game, equip Taiping Arts. After another Qun character deals damage, if you have Ghostly Path, gain two Dao Soldiers, up to four this way per round.

skills.description_cn: 锁定技。①你使用【杀】无次数限制。②若你的装备区内有武器牌，则你使用【杀】无距离限制。③当你于出牌阶段内使用第二张及以后【杀】时，你获得如下效果：{此【杀】不可被响应且伤害值基数+1；此【杀】指定目标后，目标角色的非锁定技于本回合内失效；此【杀】造成伤害后，若目标角色存活，则你失去1点体力并随机弃置一张手牌。}
skills.description_en: Compulsory. Slash has no usage limit for you. With a weapon equipped, Slash has no distance limit. From your second Slash onward in each Play Phase: it cannot be responded to and its Base Damage Value increases by 1; its targets' non-compulsory skills are disabled this turn; after it deals damage, if the target survives, Lose 1 HP and randomly discard one hand card.

skills.description_cn: 准备阶段开始时，你可以和一名其他角色进行〖协力〗。其的下个结束阶段开始时，若你与其协力成功，则你可以选择至多三名其他角色。你对这些角色视为使用一张【杀】，且当此【杀】因执行牌面效果造成伤害后，你摸X张牌（X为伤害值）。
skills.description_en: At the start of your Preparation Phase, you may establish Cooperation with another character. At the start of their next End Phase, if it succeeds, choose up to three other characters and be treated as Using Slash on them. After that Slash deals damage through its card effect, draw cards equal to that damage.

skills.description_cn: ①出牌阶段限一次。你可以将两张手牌当【万箭齐发】使用。②每回合限三次，当其他角色因响应你使用的【万箭齐发】而打出【闪】时，你摸一张牌。
skills.description_en: Once per Play Phase, you may Use two hand cards as Arrow Barrage. Up to three times per turn, when another character Plays Dodge in response to your Arrow Barrage, draw one card.

skills.description_cn: 主公技，锁定技。①你的手牌上限+2X（X为场上其他群势力角色数）。②每回合限两次，当你使用牌指定其他群势力角色为目标后，你摸一张牌。
skills.description_en: Lord; compulsory. Your Hand Limit increases by twice the number of other Qun characters. Twice per turn, after you target another Qun character with a card, draw one card.

skills.description_cn: 每轮限一次。其他角色受到伤害后，若其因此伤害触发过护甲效果且其没有护甲，则你可弃置两张手牌，令其获得X点护甲（X为其因此伤害触发护甲效果而失去的护甲数量）。
skills.description_en: Once per round, after another character Takes damage that consumed Shield, if they now have no Shield, you may discard two hand cards to restore Shield equal to what that damage consumed.

skills.description_cn: 结束阶段，你可以令一名其他角色获得1点护甲。然后其可以交给你一张牌。
skills.description_en: During your End Phase, you may have another character gain 1 Shield. They may then give you one card.
