source_reference.note: English translated from this pinned community rules record. The publisher confirms this name in the Shenmo box; compare the Chinese skills with your printed card to confirm its revision. Digital updates can differ from physical printings.

skills.description_cn: 锁定技。出牌阶段开始时，你须选择至多X张花色各不相同的手牌（X为未被此技能记录的其他角色数），将这些牌随机交给这些角色中的等量角色。然后这些角色依次选择一项：1.对你使用一张【杀】，然后你记录其；2.交给你一张牌，然后你摸一张牌。若这些角色均选择了同一项，你可令一名未被记录的角色视为使用一张【杀】。
skills.description_en: Compulsory. At the start of your Play Phase, choose up to X hand cards of different suits and randomly give them to that many unrecorded other characters, where X is the number of such characters. Each recipient chooses in order: Use Slash on you and become recorded; or give you one card, then you draw one card. If all choose the same option, you may have an unrecorded character be treated as Using Slash.

skills.description_cn: 当你受到其他角色造成的伤害后，你可选择一名不为伤害来源的其他角色。该角色可以视为对伤害来源使用一张【杀】（无距离限制）。若其因此【杀】造成了伤害，则你回复1点体力，其摸一张牌。
skills.description_en: After you Take damage from another character, you may choose a different other character. They may be treated as Using Slash on the source with no distance limit. If it deals damage, you recover 1 HP and they draw one card.

source_reference.label: Chinese rules reference · Noname
source_reference.note: English translated from this pinned community rules record. The publisher confirms this name in the Shenmo box; compare the Chinese skills with your printed card to confirm its revision. Digital updates can differ from physical printings.

skills.description_cn: 出牌阶段限一次。你可以选择两名有牌的其他角色，你与这些角色同时将任意张牌扣置于武将牌上。若你以此法扣置的牌唯一最少，则扣置牌最多的其他角色获得你扣置的牌，且这些角色获得各自扣置的牌；否则这两名角色中扣置牌较多的角色对较少的角色造成1点伤害，获得你扣置的牌，然后这些角色将各自扣置的牌置入弃牌堆（若这两名角色扣置的牌数相同，视为与你逆时针最近座次的角色扣置牌较多）。
skills.description_en: Once per Play Phase, choose two other characters with cards. You and they simultaneously place any number of cards face down on your General Cards. If your count is uniquely lowest, the other character with the most takes your set, and both others regain their own sets. Otherwise, the other character with more cards deals 1 damage to the one with fewer, gains your set, and both put their own sets in the discard pile. Ties between them favor the one closest to you counterclockwise.

skills.description_cn: 当你受到伤害后，你可以令一名角色摸四张牌，然后其可以弃置任意张牌。若其弃置的牌数小于X，你失去1点体力（X为你已损失的体力值，至少为1）。
skills.description_en: After you Take damage, you may have a character draw four cards, then discard any number. If they discard fewer than your lost HP, with a minimum requirement of one, Lose 1 HP.

source_reference.label: Chinese rules reference · Noname
source_reference.note: English translated from this pinned community rules record. The publisher confirms this name in the Shenmo box; compare the Chinese skills with your printed card to confirm its revision. Digital updates can differ from physical printings.

skills.description_cn: 出牌阶段限一次。你可以与一名其他角色进行谋弈。若你赢，且你选择的选项为：“围城断粮”，若其判定区没有【兵粮寸断】，你将牌堆顶牌当【兵粮寸断】对其使用，否则你获得其一张牌；“擂鼓进军”，你视为对其使用一张【决斗】。
skills.description_en: Once per Play Phase, you may hold a Strategy Contest with another character. If you win with Siege and Starve, Use the top card as Supply Shortage on them if their Judgment Zone lacks one; otherwise gain one of their cards. If you win with Beat the Drums, you are treated as Using Duel on them.

skills.description_cn: 结束阶段，你可以令一名体力少于你的角色或所有判定区有【兵粮寸断】的其他角色选择一项：1.交给你一张手牌；2.受到1点伤害。所有目标角色选择完成后，你可以将任意张你以此法得到的牌交给一名其他角色。
skills.description_en: During your End Phase, you may choose one character with less HP than you, or all other characters with Supply Shortage in their Judgment Zones. Each chooses: give you one hand card; or take 1 damage. After all choices, you may give any cards gained this way to one other character.

source_reference.label: Chinese rules reference · Noname
source_reference.note: English translated from this pinned community rules record. The publisher confirms this name in the Shenmo box; compare the Chinese skills with your printed card to confirm its revision. Digital updates can differ from physical printings.

skills.description_cn: ①出牌阶段限三次，你可以交给一名没有“天香”标记的其他角色一张红色手牌，然后令其获得此牌花色的“天香”标记。②当你受到伤害时，你可以移去一名角色的“天香”标记，若此“天香”标记为：红桃，你防止此伤害，其受到伤害来源对其造成的1点伤害（若没有伤害来源则改为无来源伤害）；方片，其交给你两张牌。③准备阶段，你移去场上所有的“天香”标记，然后摸等量的牌。
skills.description_en: Three times per Play Phase, you may give a red hand card to another character without a Fragrance token, giving them a token of that suit. When you Take damage, you may remove one character's token: heart prevents your damage and has them take 1 damage from the same source, or no source if absent; diamond has them give you two cards. During your Preparation Phase, remove all Fragrance tokens and draw that many cards.

skills.description_cn: 锁定技，你的♠牌和♠判定牌的花色视为♥。一名角色的判定结果生效前，若判定结果为♥，则你将其改为一种花色。
skills.description_en: Compulsory. Your spade cards and spade judgment cards are treated as hearts. Before a character's heart judgment result takes effect, change it to a suit of your choice.

source_reference.label: Chinese rules reference · Noname
source_reference.note: English translated from this pinned community rules record. The publisher confirms this name in the Shenmo box; compare the Chinese skills with your printed card to confirm its revision. Digital updates can differ from physical printings.

skills.description_cn: 回合开始时，你可以选择并执行以下任意项：①跳过判定阶段和摸牌阶段；②跳过摸牌阶段和出牌阶段；③跳过出牌阶段和弃牌阶段。你每选择一项，视为使用一张无距离限制的【杀】（连续使用的【杀】不可指定相同目标；若对应选项包含出牌阶段，则此【杀】不可被响应）。若你选择的项中包含重复阶段，则你将武将牌翻面。
skills.description_en: At turn start, you may choose any of: skip Judgment and Draw Phases; skip Draw and Play Phases; skip Play and Discard Phases. For each, be treated as Using Slash with no distance limit. Consecutive Slashes cannot target the same character; a Slash from an option including Play Phase cannot be responded to. If chosen options share a phase, Flip your General Card.

skills.description_cn: 回合结束时，若你本回合造成的伤害不少于你的体力值，则你可以回复1点体力并复原武将牌。
skills.description_en: At turn end, if the damage you dealt this turn is at least your HP Value, you may recover 1 HP and restore your General Card face up and not sideways.

source_reference.label: Chinese rules reference · Noname
source_reference.note: English translated from this pinned community rules record. The publisher confirms this name in the Shenmo box; compare the Chinese skills with your printed card to confirm its revision. Digital updates can differ from physical printings.

skills.description_cn: 每回合限一次。当你受到其他角色造成的伤害后，其可以令你回复等同于此次伤害值的体力，然后其摸两张牌。
skills.description_en: Once per turn, after another character deals damage to you, they may have you recover HP equal to that damage, then draw two cards.

skills.description_cn: ①出牌阶段限两次。你可以弃置一张【杀】，然后摸一张牌。②出牌阶段结束时，你可以令一名其他角色摸3X张牌（X为你于此阶段发动〖燕语①〗的次数）。
skills.description_en: Twice per Play Phase, you may discard a Slash to draw one card. At phase end, you may have another character draw three cards per activation of that effect this phase.

source_reference.label: Chinese rules reference · Noname
source_reference.note: English translated from this pinned community rules record. The publisher confirms this name in the Shenmo box; compare the Chinese skills with your printed card to confirm its revision. Digital updates can differ from physical printings.

skills.description_cn: 当你受到伤害后，你可选择一项：1.弃置你或伤害来源的一张牌，若此牌为黑色，执行选项2；2.对伤害来源造成1点伤害，若你与其手牌数相同，执行选项1。
skills.description_en: After you Take damage, you may choose: discard one card from yourself or the source, and if it is black, perform option 2; or deal 1 damage to the source, and if your hand sizes match, perform option 1.

skills.description_cn: 每轮每名角色限一次，一名角色的仅一张牌被弃置后，你可令其获得之，然后你摸一张牌。
skills.description_en: Once per character each round, after exactly one of their cards is discarded, you may have them regain it, then draw one card.

source_reference.label: Chinese rules reference · Noname
source_reference.note: English translated from this pinned community rules record. The publisher confirms this name in the Shenmo box; compare the Chinese skills with your printed card to confirm its revision. Digital updates can differ from physical printings.

skills.description_cn: 当你使用【杀】或普通锦囊牌指定唯一其他角色为目标时，你可从逆时针方向和顺时针方向中选择一个你与其之间角色最少的方向。你令该方向下你与其之间的所有能成为此牌额外目标的角色均成为此牌的目标。
skills.description_en: When Slash or a Non-Time-Delayed Tool Card you Use targets exactly one other character, choose a direction, clockwise or counterclockwise, with the fewest characters between you and them. Add every eligible character between you in that direction as a target.

skills.description_cn: ①准备阶段，你可记录一名未被〖追讨〗记录过的其他角色直到你对其造成伤害后。②你至所有〖追讨〗记录过的角色的距离-1。
skills.description_en: During your Preparation Phase, you may record another character not already recorded, until after you damage them. Reduce your Distance to all recorded characters by 1.

source_reference.label: Chinese rules reference · Noname
source_reference.note: English translated from this pinned community rules record. The publisher confirms this name in the Shenmo box; compare the Chinese skills with your printed card to confirm its revision. Digital updates can differ from physical printings.

skills.description_cn: 使命技。①你的登场势力为蜀。②游戏开始时，你选择并记录一名其他角色，称为“结姻”角色。③“结姻”角色死亡后，你减少1点体力上限；“结姻”角色的出牌阶段开始时，你选择一项：1.令其获得1点护甲；2.你获得其至多X张牌（X为游戏轮数且至多为3），然后将势力变更为吴。④成功：若“结姻”角色护甲值为5，你每轮首次发动〖枭姬〗后获得1点护甲。⑤成功：若“结姻”角色装备区牌数为4，你发动〖枭姬〗后，本回合使用【杀】的次数上限+1。⑥失败：若“结姻”角色死亡或你的势力为吴，你清除“结姻”记录，重铸所有红桃手牌，然后摸两张牌。
skills.description_en: Mission. Begin as Shu and record one other character as your spouse at game start. When your spouse dies, reduce your Max HP by 1. At the start of their Play Phase, choose: they gain 1 Shield; or gain up to X of their cards and become Wu, where X is the round number, capped at 3. Success at 5 spouse Shield: gain 1 Shield after your first Warrior Princess activation each round. Success at four spouse equipped cards: after activating Warrior Princess, increase your Slash limit this turn by 1. Failure if your spouse dies or you become Wu: clear the spouse record, Recast all heart hand cards, then draw two cards.

skills.description_cn: 蜀势力技，锁定技。①你或“结姻”角色回复体力后，对方摸一张牌。②出牌阶段结束时，若你已受伤，你回复1点体力；否则你观看三张装备牌，然后选择交给一名“结姻”角色（若其对应装备栏为空置则其使用之）。
skills.description_en: Shu faction; compulsory. After you or your spouse recovers HP, the other draws one card. At the end of your Play Phase, if wounded, recover 1 HP; otherwise, look at three Equipment Cards and choose one to give to your spouse, who Uses it if its corresponding slot is empty.

skills.description_cn: ①你失去装备区里的一张牌后，你摸两张牌。②若你：有失败的使命技，你因〖枭姬①〗执行摸牌后可以弃置场上一张牌；有成功的使命技，你可以于“结姻”角色失去装备后发动〖枭姬①〗。
skills.description_en: After you lose one card from your Equipment Zone, draw two cards. If you have a failed Mission, after this draw you may discard one card on the field. If you have a successful Mission, you may also activate the draw after your spouse loses Equipment.

source_reference.label: Chinese rules reference · Noname
source_reference.note: English translated from this pinned community rules record. The publisher confirms this name in the Shenmo box; compare the Chinese skills with your printed card to confirm its revision. Digital updates can differ from physical printings.

skills.description_cn: 出牌阶段限一次，你可弃置任意张牌并摸等量+X张牌（X为你因此弃置牌后牌数相等的区域数且不可为1）。
skills.description_en: Once per Play Phase, you may discard any number of cards and draw that many plus X. X is the number of your zones with equal card counts after discarding, and cannot be 1.

skills.description_cn: 锁定技，回合结束时，若你每个区域均有与你此区域牌数相同的其他角色，你从牌堆或弃牌堆中随机获得一张未以此法获得过的牌名的牌。
skills.description_en: Compulsory. At turn end, if for each of your zones some other character has the same card count in their corresponding zone, randomly gain a card from the deck or discard pile with a name you have not gained this way before.

skills.description_cn: 主公技，锁定技。①其他吴势力角色使用【桃】时，你摸一张牌。②其他吴势力角色对你使用的【桃】的回复量+1。
skills.description_en: Lord; compulsory. When another Wu character Uses Peach, draw one card. Peaches other Wu characters Use on you recover one additional HP.

skills.description_cn: ①当你使用【决斗】或红色【杀】指定目标后，或当你成为【决斗】或红色【杀】的目标后，你摸一张牌。②当你使用【决斗】时，你可以额外指定一名目标，然后你失去1点体力。③出牌阶段限一次。你可以将所有手牌当【决斗】使用。
skills.description_en: After you target a character with Duel or a red Slash, or become a target of either, draw one card. When you Use Duel, you may add one target, then Lose 1 HP. Once per Play Phase, you may Use all your hand cards as Duel.

skills.description_cn: 觉醒技。当你脱离濒死状态后，你减1点体力上限，获得1点护甲，摸三张牌。然后你获得〖英姿〗和〖英魂〗。
skills.description_en: Awakening. After you leave a Dying Event, reduce your Max HP by 1, gain 1 Shield, draw three cards, then gain Heroic Bearing and Heroic Soul.

skills.description_cn: 主公技，限定技。当你进入濒死状态时，你可以回复X-1点体力并修改〖激昂③〗为“出牌阶段限X次”（X为场上其他吴势力角色数+1）。然后其他吴势力角色依次受到1点无来源伤害，且当有角色因此死亡后，你摸三张牌。
skills.description_en: Lord; limited. When you enter a Dying Event, you may recover X-1 HP and change Roused Spirit's all-hand Duel limit to X times per Play Phase. X is the number of other Wu characters plus 1. Then those Wu characters each take 1 damage with no source in order. Whenever one dies this way, draw three cards.

skills.description_cn: 锁定技。摸牌阶段，你多摸X张牌，且令你本回合手牌上限+X（X为以下条件中你满足的项数：手牌数不小于2、体力值不小于2、装备区里的牌数不小于1）。
skills.description_en: Compulsory. During your Draw Phase, draw X additional cards and increase your Hand Limit by X this turn. X is the number of conditions met: at least two hand cards; at least 2 HP; at least one equipped card.

skills.description_cn: 准备阶段开始时，若你已受伤，你可令一名其他角色执行一项：摸X张牌，然后弃置一张牌；或摸一张牌，然后弃置X张牌（X为你已损失的体力值）。
skills.description_en: At the start of your Preparation Phase, if wounded, you may have another character choose the effect you specify: draw X cards then discard one; or draw one then discard X. X is your lost HP.

skills.description_cn: ①出牌阶段，你可以重铸一张♣手牌。②出牌阶段限一次。你可以将一张♣手牌当【铁索连环】使用。③当你使用【铁索连环】时，你可以失去1点体力，然后当此牌指定第一个目标后，你随机弃置每名不处于连环状态的目标角色一张手牌。
skills.description_en: During your Play Phase, you may Recast a club hand card. Once per Play Phase, you may Use a club hand card as Iron Chain. When you Use Iron Chain, you may Lose 1 HP; after it designates its first target, randomly discard one hand card from each target not already Chained.

skills.description_cn: 限定技。当你处于濒死状态时，你可以弃置区域里的所有牌，摸两张牌，将体力回复至2点，复原武将牌，然后修改〖连环〗。
skills.description_en: Limited. During your Dying Event, you may discard all cards in your zones, draw two cards, recover to 2 HP, restore your General Card face up and not sideways, then upgrade Linked Chains.

skills.description_cn: ①出牌阶段，你可以重铸一张♣手牌。②出牌阶段限一次。你可以将一张♣手牌当【铁索连环】使用。③当你使用【铁索连环】时，你可以额外指定任意名角色为目标。④当你使用【铁索连环】指定第一个目标后，你随机弃置每名不处于连环状态的目标角色一张手牌。
skills.description_en: During your Play Phase, you may Recast a club hand card. Once per Play Phase, you may Use a club hand card as Iron Chain. When you Use Iron Chain, you may add any number of targets. After it designates its first target, randomly discard one hand card from every target not already Chained.

source_reference.note: English translated from this pinned community rules record. The publisher confirms this name in the Shenmo box; compare the Chinese skills with your printed card to confirm its revision. Digital updates can differ from physical printings.

skills.description_cn: 锁定技。①【南蛮入侵】对你无效。②当其他角色使用【南蛮入侵】指定第一个目标后，你代替其成为此牌的伤害来源。③出牌阶段开始时，你随机获得弃牌堆中的一张【南蛮入侵】。④出牌阶段，若你于此阶段使用过【南蛮入侵】，你不能使用【南蛮入侵】。
skills.description_en: Compulsory. Barbarian Invasion is Nullified against you. When another character's Barbarian Invasion designates its first target, Substitute yourself as its damage source. At the start of your Play Phase, gain a random Barbarian Invasion from the discard pile. You cannot Use Barbarian Invasion more than once per Play Phase.

skills.description_cn: 蓄力技（0/7）。①弃牌阶段结束时，你可以消耗任意点蓄力值并选择等量名角色，然后令这些角色选择一项：1.令你摸一张牌；2.弃置一张牌，然后你回复1点体力。②每回合限一次。当你造成伤害后，你获得1点蓄力值。
skills.description_en: Charge (0/7). At the end of your Discard Phase, you may spend any amount of Charge and choose that many characters. Each chooses: have you draw one card; or discard one card and have you recover 1 HP. Once per turn, after you deal damage, gain 1 Charge.

skills.description_cn: 锁定技，你计算与其他角色的距离时-1。
skills.description_en: Compulsory. Reduce your Distance to other characters by 1.

skills.description_cn: 当你使用【杀】指定其他角色为目标后，你可以令目标角色不能响应此【杀】，且其所有非锁定技失效直到回合结束。然后你与其进行谋弈。若你赢，且你选择的选项为：“直取敌营”，则你获得其一张牌；“扰阵疲敌”，你摸两张牌。
skills.description_en: After your Slash targets another character, you may prevent them from responding to it and disable all their non-compulsory skills until turn end. Then hold a Strategy Contest with them. If you win with Strike the Camp, gain one of their cards; if you win with Disrupt the Formation, draw two cards.

skills.description_cn: ①出牌阶段各限一次。你可以选择一项：1.弃置一张手牌，然后获得1点护甲；2.失去1点体力，然后获得2点护甲。②你的手牌上限+X（X为你的护甲数）。③若你不为正在结算濒死流程的角色，你不能使用【桃】。
skills.description_en: Each option once per Play Phase: discard one hand card to gain 1 Shield; or Lose 1 HP to gain 2 Shield. Your Hand Limit increases by your Shield count. You cannot Use Peach unless you are the character whose Dying Event is being resolved.

skills.description_cn: 觉醒技。准备阶段，若你的护甲数不少于3，你获得〖夺荆〗，修改〖克己①〗为“出牌阶段限一次”。
skills.description_en: Awakening. During your Preparation Phase, if you have at least 3 Shield, gain Seize Jingzhou and change Self-Discipline's first effect to once per Play Phase total.

skills.description_cn: 当你使用【杀】指定目标时，你可以失去1点护甲。然后令此【杀】无视防具，你获得目标角色一张手牌，本回合使用【杀】的次数上限+1。
skills.description_en: When your Slash designates a target, you may lose 1 Shield. The Slash then Ignores armor, you gain one of the target's hand cards, and your Slash limit this turn increases by 1.

source_reference.label: Chinese rules reference · Noname
source_reference.note: English translated from this pinned community rules record. The publisher confirms this name in the Shenmo box; compare the Chinese skills with your printed card to confirm its revision. Digital updates can differ from physical printings.

skills.description_cn: 锁定技。①你使用的【杀】需两张【闪】才能抵消；与你进行【决斗】的角色每次需要打出两张【杀】。②每回合限两次，当你使用【杀】或【决斗】造成伤害时，若受伤角色没有使用或打出过【杀】或【闪】响应此牌，则此伤害+1。
skills.description_en: Compulsory. Your Slash needs two Dodges to be Negated; opponents in a Duel with you need to Play two Slashes each response. Twice per turn, when your Slash or Duel deals damage, if that character did not Use or Play Slash or Dodge in response to it, increase that damage by 1.

skills.description_cn: 当你使用【杀】对一名其他角色造成伤害后，你可获得其区域内至多等同于伤害值张牌，然后其摸等量张牌。若你与其因此获得了全部类型的牌，其选择一项：①你视为对其指定的另一名其他角色使用一张【决斗】；②其获得〖无双〗直至其回合结束。
skills.description_en: After your Slash damages another character, you may gain cards from their zones up to the damage amount; they draw that many. If the cards gained between you include all three types, they choose: you are treated as Using Duel on a different character they select; or they gain Peerless until their turn ends.

skills.description_cn: 锁定技，①当你使用【杀】指定一名角色为目标后，其需使用两张【闪】才能抵消；②当你使用【决斗】指定其他角色为目标后，或成为其他角色使用【决斗】的目标后，其每次响应需打出两张【杀】。
skills.description_en: Compulsory. Targets of your Slash need to Use two Dodges to Negate it. In a Duel you Use or are targeted by, the opposing character needs to Play two Slashes for each response.

source_reference.label: Chinese rules reference · Noname
source_reference.note: English translated from this pinned community rules record. The publisher confirms this name in the Shenmo box; compare the Chinese skills with your printed card to confirm its revision. Digital updates can differ from physical printings.

skills.description_cn: 当一张锦囊牌对你生效时，若此牌名未记录且你不是使用者，则你记录之，然后可将至多X张牌置于你的武将牌上，此回合结束时获得（X为“谦逊”记录的牌名数且至多为5）。出牌阶段开始时，你可以移去一个记录的牌名，若为普通锦囊牌则可以视为使用此牌。
skills.description_en: When a Tool Card Used by someone else takes effect on you, if its name is unrecorded, record it, then you may place up to X cards on your General Card and regain them at turn end. X is the number of recorded names, capped at 5. At the start of your Play Phase, you may remove one recorded name; if it is a Non-Time-Delayed Tool Card, you may be treated as Using it.

skills.description_cn: 其他角色的回合结束时，你可以观看牌堆顶的X张牌，然后将这些牌交给任意角色（X为你本回合失去的牌数+1，至多为5）。
skills.description_en: At the end of another character's turn, you may look at the top X cards and distribute them among any characters. X is the number of cards you lost this turn plus 1, capped at 5.

source_reference.label: Chinese rules reference · Noname
source_reference.note: English translated from this pinned community rules record. The publisher confirms this name in the Shenmo box; compare the Chinese skills with your printed card to confirm its revision. Digital updates can differ from physical printings.

skills.description_cn: 锁定技，游戏开始时或者“任”牌进入弃牌堆后，你摸两张牌，然后将一张手牌扣置于一名角色的武将牌上，称为“任”。
skills.description_en: Compulsory. At game start, or after a Duty card enters the discard pile, draw two cards and place one hand card face down on a character's General Card as Duty.

skills.description_cn: 每轮每项限一次，有“任”的角色回合开始时，你可以选择一项执行：1.弃置X张与“任”颜色相同的牌，对一名角色造成1点伤害；2.从牌堆获得X张与“任”颜色相同的牌。（X为你本局游戏“明任”的发动次数）该角色的回合结束时，若其本回合达成了你未执行的一项，你将其“任”置入弃牌堆。
skills.description_en: Each option once per round, at the start of a Duty holder's turn, you may: discard X cards matching Duty's color and deal 1 damage to a character; or gain X cards matching that color from the deck. X is your number of Clear Appointment activations this game. At that turn's end, if the holder fulfilled the option you did not choose, put their Duty in the discard pile.

source_reference.label: Chinese rules reference · Noname
source_reference.note: English translated from this pinned community rules record. The publisher confirms this name in the Shenmo box; compare the Chinese skills with your printed card to confirm its revision. Digital updates can differ from physical printings.

skills.description_cn: 出牌阶段，若你本阶段内因〖战绝〗得到过的牌数小于3，则你可以将所有不具有“勤王”标记的手牌当做【决斗】使用。此【决斗】使用结算结束后，你摸一张牌。然后所有因此【决斗】受到过伤害的角色也各摸一张牌。
skills.description_en: During your Play Phase, if you have gained fewer than three cards through Decisive Battle this phase, you may Use all hand cards without Royal Aid marks as Duel. After it resolves, draw one card, then every character damaged by that Duel also draws one card.

skills.description_cn: 主公技。出牌阶段限一次，你可以令所有其他蜀势力角色依次选择是否交给你一张【杀】，然后你可以令选择是的角色摸一张牌。
skills.description_en: Lord. Once per Play Phase, you may have all other Shu characters choose in order whether to give you a Slash. You may have those who agree each draw one card.

source_reference.label: Chinese rules reference · Noname
source_reference.note: English translated from this pinned community rules record. The publisher confirms this name in the Shenmo box; compare the Chinese skills with your printed card to confirm its revision. Digital updates can differ from physical printings.

skills.description_cn: 蓄力技（0/8）。①出牌阶段每名角色限一次。你可以将任意张牌交给一名其他角色，然后你获得等量蓄力点。②每回合限一次。你可以移去2点蓄力点，视为使用或打出一张基本牌。③出牌阶段开始时，你获得2点蓄力点。
skills.description_en: Charge (0/8). Once per other character each Play Phase, you may give them any number of cards and gain that much Charge. Once per turn, you may spend 2 Charge to be treated as Using or Playing a Basic Card. At the start of your Play Phase, gain 2 Charge.

skills.description_cn: 锁定技，你或一名因“仁德”获得过牌的角色杀死角色后，你摸三张牌；一名因“仁德”获得过牌的角色死亡后，你的蓄力技上限减半（向上取整）且出【杀】次数与攻击范围+1，然后你选择一种颜色，本局游戏你此颜色的手牌只能当【杀】（黑色为雷【杀】，红色为火【杀】）使用或打出。
skills.description_en: Compulsory. After you or a recipient of Benevolence kills a character, draw three cards. After a Benevolence recipient dies, halve your Charge capacity, rounding up, and increase your Slash limit and Attack Range by 1. Choose a color: for the rest of the game, your hand cards of that color may only be Used or Played as Slashes, thunder for black or fire for red.

skills.description_cn: 主公技。出牌阶段结束时，你可以选择一名体力值不小于你的其他蜀势力角色A和一名在A攻击范围内的角色B。A选择一项：1.视为对B使用一张【杀】；2.下一个出牌阶段开始前，跳过此阶段。
skills.description_en: Lord. At the end of your Play Phase, choose another Shu character A whose HP Value is at least yours and a character B within A's Attack Range. A chooses: be treated as Using Slash on B; or skip their next Play Phase before it starts.

source_reference.label: Chinese rules reference · Noname
source_reference.note: English translated from this pinned community rules record. The publisher confirms this name in the Shenmo box; compare the Chinese skills with your printed card to confirm its revision. Digital updates can differ from physical printings.

skills.description_cn: 出牌阶段限一次，你可以选择一项并令一名其他角色执行：1.将一张手牌当作【决斗】对你使用，否则本回合不能使用或打出牌；2.对你使用一张【杀】，否则你弃置其一张牌。〖背水〗：本回合你与其受到的伤害+1。
skills.description_en: Once per Play Phase, have another character perform an option: Use a hand card as Duel on you, or be unable to Use or Play cards this turn; or Use Slash on you, or you discard one of their cards. Backwater: increase damage both you and they Take this turn by 1 to perform both options.

skills.description_cn: 觉醒技。准备阶段，若你的手牌数不大于体力值，你减少1点体力上限，回复1点体力并摸两张牌，获得〖北伐〗。
skills.description_en: Awakening. During your Preparation Phase, if your hand size is at most your HP Value, reduce your Max HP by 1, recover 1 HP, draw two cards, and gain Northern Expedition.

skills.description_cn: 蓄力技（3/9）。①出牌阶段限一次，你可以消耗任意点蓄力值，将一张手牌当做等字数且未被记录的仅能对其他角色使用的牌使用或打出，然后记录之。②你于回合内受到伤害或〖北伐〗记录牌名数达到X时，清除所有记录，然后若X大于1，蓄力值上限-1（X为此技能提供的蓄力值上限）。③你的回合内，有转化牌被使用或打出时或有牌被弃置时，你获得对应实体牌数点蓄力值。
skills.description_en: Charge (3/9). Once per Play Phase, spend any amount of Charge to Use or Play a hand card as an unrecorded card with an equally long Chinese name that can only be Used on other characters, then record its name. During your turn, after you Take damage or the recorded name count reaches the Charge capacity, clear all names; if capacity exceeds 1, reduce it by 1. During your turn, whenever converted cards are Used or Played or cards are discarded, gain Charge equal to their physical card count.

source_reference.label: Chinese rules reference · Noname
source_reference.note: English translated from this pinned community rules record. The publisher confirms this name in the Shenmo box; compare the Chinese skills with your printed card to confirm its revision. Digital updates can differ from physical printings.

skills.description_cn: ①你的回合内，不处于濒死状态的其他角色不能使用【桃】。②每轮限两次，一名角色进入濒死状态时，你可以观看其手牌并选择其中零至三张牌（其他人不可见），然后其选择一项：1.你将这些牌分配给任意名不为其的角色；2.其弃置除这些牌以外的牌。
skills.description_en: During your turn, other characters not in a Dying Event cannot Use Peach. Twice per round, when a character enters a Dying Event, you may look at their hand and secretly select zero to three cards. They choose: you distribute those cards among any characters except them; or they discard all their other cards.

skills.description_cn: 限定技，出牌阶段，你可令所有其他角色依次选择一项：①对距离最近（或之一）的另一名其他角色使用一张【杀】；②失去1点体力。一名角色因此失去体力后，你可以修改〖完杀〗或者〖帷幕〗。
skills.description_en: Limited. During your Play Phase, have all other characters choose in order: Use Slash on one of their nearest other characters; or Lose 1 HP. After a character Loses HP this way, you may upgrade Complete Kill or Curtain.

skills.description_cn: 锁定技。当你成为黑色锦囊牌的目标时，取消之。
skills.description_en: Compulsory. When you become a target of a black Tool Card, Remove yourself as a target.

skills.description_cn: ①你的回合内，不处于濒死状态的其他角色不能使用【桃】。②每轮限两次，一名角色进入濒死状态时，你可以观看其手牌并选择其区域内的零至三张牌（其他人不可见），然后其选择一项：1.你将这些牌分配给任意名不为其的角色；2.其弃置除这些牌以外的牌。
skills.description_en: During your turn, other characters not in a Dying Event cannot Use Peach. Twice per round, when a character enters a Dying Event, look at their hand and secretly select zero to three cards from their zones. They choose: you distribute those cards among any characters except them; or they discard all their other cards.

skills.description_cn: 锁定技。①当你成为黑色锦囊牌的目标时，取消之。②每轮开始时，你从弃牌堆中随机获得一张黑色锦囊牌或防具牌。
skills.description_en: Compulsory. When you become a target of a black Tool Card, Remove yourself as a target. At the start of each round, randomly gain a black Tool Card or armor from the discard pile.

skills.description_cn: ①若你的装备区内没有武器牌，则你手牌区内所有【杀】的属性视为无属性。②当你使用牌时，或成为其他角色使用牌的目标后，你记录此牌的花色。③当你使用【杀】指定唯一目标后，若你〖烈弓②〗的记录不为空，则你可亮出牌堆顶的X张牌（X为你〖烈弓②〗记录过的花色数-1），令此【杀】的伤害值基数+Y（Y为亮出牌中被〖烈弓②〗记录过花色的牌的数量），且目标角色不能使用〖烈弓②〗记录过花色的牌响应此【杀】。此【杀】使用结算结束后，你清除〖烈弓②〗的记录。
skills.description_en: Without a weapon equipped, all Slashes in your hand are treated as non-elemental. When you Use a card or another character targets you with a card, record its suit. After your Slash designates a sole target, if suits are recorded, you may Reveal X cards, where X is the recorded suit count minus 1. Increase the Slash's Base Damage Value by the count of Revealed cards with recorded suits, and prevent the target responding with recorded suits. Clear the records after that Slash resolves.

skills.description_cn: 锁定技，当你使用一张普通锦囊牌时，你摸一张牌，且此牌本回合不计入你的手牌上限。
skills.description_en: Compulsory. When you Use a Non-Time-Delayed Tool Card, draw one card; it does not count toward your Hand Limit this turn.

skills.description_cn: ①出牌阶段限一次。你可以将手牌中或弃牌堆中的一张装备牌置于一名其他角色的对应装备栏，然后其获得如下效果：当其得到普通锦囊牌后，其将此牌交给你（限三张）。②你使用锦囊牌无距离限制。
skills.description_en: Once per Play Phase, place an Equipment Card from your hand or the discard pile in another character's corresponding slot. When that character gains Non-Time-Delayed Tool Cards, they give them to you, up to three cards. Your Tool Cards have no distance limit.

skills.description_cn: ①出牌阶段开始时，你可以交给其他角色一张牌，若此牌为【桃】或【酒】，你失去2点体力，否则你失去1点体力。②当你失去1点体力后，你获得2点护甲。
skills.description_en: At the start of your Play Phase, you may give another character one card. Lose 2 HP if it is Peach or Wine, otherwise Lose 1 HP. After you Lose each 1 HP, gain 2 Shield.

skills.description_cn: 锁定技。①摸牌阶段，你多摸X张牌。②你于回合内使用的前X张牌无距离与次数限制且不能被响应（X为你已损失的体力值）。
skills.description_en: Compulsory. During your Draw Phase, draw X additional cards. The first X cards you Use during your turn have no distance or usage limits and cannot be responded to. X is your lost HP.

skills.description_cn: 锁定技，当一名角色使用【杀】对你造成伤害时，若此【杀】为红色，该角色回复1点体力或摸一张牌。否则你摸一张牌。
skills.description_en: Compulsory. When a character damages you with Slash, if it is red, they recover 1 HP or draw one card. Otherwise, you draw one card.

skills.description_cn: 出牌阶段，你可以摸两张牌，令此技能于你的下下个结束阶段前失效，且你获得如下效果直到回合结束：使用【杀】无距离限制，次数上限+1且无视防具。
skills.description_en: During your Play Phase, you may draw two cards and disable this skill until your second upcoming End Phase. Until turn end, your Slashes have no distance limit, Ignore armor, and their usage limit increases by 1.

skills.description_cn: ①出牌阶段开始时，你可以弃置一张牌，然后本阶段你获得如下效果：当你使用牌时，你令所有其他角色只能使用或打出与你弃置牌颜色相同的手牌响应此牌。②你的攻击范围+4。
skills.description_en: At the start of your Play Phase, you may discard one card. For this phase, other characters may only respond to cards you Use by Using or Playing hand cards matching that discarded card's color. Your Attack Range increases by 4.

skills.description_cn: 出牌阶段限一次，你可以令一名角色选择一项：⒈令所有攻击范围内含有其的角色依次弃置一张牌；⒉其摸等同于攻击范围内含有其的角色数的牌；⒊〖背水〗：此技能失效直到你杀死一名角色。
skills.description_en: Once per Play Phase, choose a character and have them choose: all characters whose Attack Range includes them discard one card in order; or draw cards equal to the number of such characters. Backwater: disable this skill until you kill a character to perform both options.

skills.description_cn: 转换技，出牌阶段开始时，阳：你可以弃置两张手牌，然后视为使用一张普通锦囊牌；阴：你进行判定并获得判定牌，然后若判定结果与你本局游戏因〖天妒〗弃置的牌花色相同，你受到1点无来源伤害。
skills.description_en: Conversion. At the start of your Play Phase, Yang: you may discard two hand cards and be treated as Using a Non-Time-Delayed Tool Card. Yin: make a judgment and gain its card; if its suit matches any card discarded through Heaven's Envy this game, take 1 damage with no source.

skills.description_cn: 当你受到伤害后，你可以摸两张牌，然后你可以将至多等量张手牌交给任意名其他角色。当你每轮首次进入濒死状态时，你可以摸两张牌，然后你可以将至多等量张牌交给任意名其他角色。
skills.description_en: After you Take damage, you may draw two cards, then give up to two hand cards among other characters. The first time each round you enter a Dying Event, you may draw two cards, then give up to two cards among other characters.

skills.description_cn: 锁定技，回合开始时，若你的武将牌上没有“精策”牌，则你清除未验证的预测记录，然后将牌堆顶的三张牌置于你的武将牌上，称为“精策”牌。回合结束时，你预测将获得这些“精策”牌的角色（或预测这些“精策”牌不被任何角色获得），然后根据预测顺序将这些牌分别置为牌堆顶的第三/六/九张牌（若牌堆剩余牌数不足，则将无法达到的牌按预测顺序置于牌堆底）。若你预测正确，则你分别摸1/2/3张牌。
skills.description_en: Compulsory. At turn start, if you have no Planning cards, clear unverified predictions and put the top three cards on your General Card as Planning. At turn end, predict who will gain each, or that nobody will. Place them third, sixth, and ninth from the top in prediction order; if the deck is too short, put unreachable cards on the bottom in that order. Correct predictions draw you one, two, or three cards respectively.

skills.description_cn: 你可以将一张手牌当作任意【杀】使用或打出。出牌阶段开始时，你可以选择一名非主公的其他角色，本阶段对其使用【杀】无距离和次数限制，使用【杀】指定其为目标后摸一张牌，对其使用三张【杀】后不能对其使用【杀】。
skills.description_en: You may Use or Play a hand card as any Slash. At the start of your Play Phase, choose another non-Lord character. Your Slashes against them this phase have no distance or usage limits, and after targeting them, draw one card. After Using three Slashes on them, you cannot Use another Slash on them this phase.

skills.description_cn: 锁定技，每名角色每局游戏限一次，一名其他角色受到你对其造成的大于等于其体力值的伤害时，你防止此伤害，且本回合你使用牌指定其为目标时，此牌对其无效。
skills.description_en: Compulsory; once per other character per game. When you would deal damage at least equal to their HP Value, prevent it. For this turn, cards you Use targeting them are Nullified against them.

skills.description_cn: 蓄力技（2/4）。①每轮开始时，你可以消耗任意点蓄力值并选择一项：⒈你于本轮内至其他角色的距离-1，令系统选择牌堆中的X张【杀】；⒉其他角色于本轮内至你的距离+1，令系统选择牌堆中的X张【闪】（X为你消耗的蓄力值）。然后你将系统选择的牌置于武将牌上，称为“扈”（至多为4）。②你可以将“扈”如手牌般使用或打出。
skills.description_en: Charge (2/4). At the start of each round, spend any amount of Charge and choose: reduce your Distance to others by 1 this round and select X Slashes from the deck; or increase others' Distance to you by 1 this round and select X Dodges. X is Charge spent. Place selected cards on your General Card as Guards, up to four. You may Use or Play Guards as though they were hand cards.

skills.description_cn: 当你使用【杀】造成伤害后，若你有〖义从〗，你可以选择一项：⒈弃置受伤角色区域里的一张牌并摸一张牌；⒉获得3点蓄力值。
skills.description_en: After your Slash deals damage, if you have Righteous Riders, you may choose: discard one card from the damaged character's zones and draw one card; or gain 3 Charge.

skills.description_cn: 出牌阶段限一次。你可以选择一名其他角色，你于本阶段获得如下效果：⒈你对其使用牌无距离限制；⒉当你使用【杀】指定其为目标后，你可以与其拼点：若你赢，此【杀】无视防具且不计入次数，且若你本回合以此法对其造成的伤害小于1，你对其造成1点伤害；若其拼点牌为【杀】，则你获得之。
skills.description_en: Once per Play Phase, choose another character. Your cards have no distance limit against them this phase. After your Slash targets them, you may Pindian with them. If you win, the Slash Ignores armor and does not count toward its usage limit; if you have dealt less than 1 damage to them this way this turn, deal 1 damage to them. If their Pindian card is Slash, gain it.

skills.description_cn: 锁定技。①你的【酒】均视为【杀】。②当你受到酒【杀】的伤害时，你令此伤害减至1。③其他角色不能于你的回合内使用【酒】。④当一名其他角色的拼点牌亮出后，若你为发起者或参与者且此牌为【酒】，则此牌的点数视为A。
skills.description_en: Compulsory. Your Wines are treated as Slashes. Damage you Take from a Wine-boosted Slash is reduced to 1. Other characters cannot Use Wine during your turn. In a Pindian you initiated or participate in, another character's Revealed Wine is treated as rank A.

skills.description_cn: 出牌阶段限一次。若你有手牌，你可以令一名其他角色猜测你手牌中最多的花色。若其猜对，你展示所有手牌；若其猜错，你可令其从其未选择过的花色中再次猜测，重复此流程。然后你弃置其区域内的X张牌（X为其于本次〖奇袭〗中猜错的次数）。
skills.description_en: Once per Play Phase, if you have hand cards, have another character guess your most numerous hand suit. If correct, Show your entire hand. If wrong, you may have them guess again from suits not yet chosen, repeating this process. Then discard cards from their zones equal to their wrong guesses.

skills.description_cn: 限定技。①出牌阶段，你可以将至多三张牌分别置于等量名角色的武将牌上，称为“威”，然后你摸等量牌。②当一名角色成为锦囊牌的目标时，若其有“威”，你须选择：1.令其获得其“威”；2.令其移去“威”，并取消此目标。
skills.description_en: Limited. During your Play Phase, place up to three cards on that many characters' General Cards as Might, then draw that many. When a Might holder becomes a Tool Card's target, you must either have them gain their Might or remove it and Remove them as a target.

source_reference.label: Chinese rules reference · Noname
source_reference.note: English translated from this pinned community rules record. The publisher confirms this name in the Shenmo box; compare the Chinese skills with your printed card to confirm its revision. Digital updates can differ from physical printings.

skills.description_cn: ①出牌阶段限一次。你可以将一张牌交给一名没有“眩”标记的其他角色，然后令其获得“眩”标记。②当有“眩”的其他角色于摸牌阶段外得到牌后，若你以此法于其本次获得“眩”的期间内得到其的牌数小于5，你随机获得其一张手牌。
skills.description_en: Once per Play Phase, give one card to another character without Dazzle and mark them. After a marked other character gains cards outside their Draw Phase, if you have taken fewer than five cards from them during this instance of Dazzle, randomly gain one of their hand cards.

skills.description_cn: 锁定技。准备阶段，若场上存在有“眩”的角色，你移去该角色的“眩”，且你于其本次获得“眩”的期间内得到其的牌数：不小于3，你交给其三张牌；小于3，其失去1点体力，你回复1点体力。
skills.description_en: Compulsory. During your Preparation Phase, remove Dazzle from each marked character. If you gained at least three cards from them during that instance, give them three cards; otherwise, they Lose 1 HP and you recover 1 HP.

source_reference.note: English translated from this pinned community rules record. The publisher confirms this name in the Shenmo box; compare the Chinese skills with your printed card to confirm its revision. Digital updates can differ from physical printings.

skills.description_cn: 出牌阶段限一次。你可以选择至少两名其他角色并弃置X张牌（X为你选择的角色数-1）。然后每名你选择的角色依次视为对这些角色中与其逆时针座次最近的另一名角色使用一张【决斗】。
skills.description_en: Once per Play Phase, choose at least two other characters and discard cards equal to their count minus 1. Each chosen character, in order, is treated as Using Duel on the nearest other chosen character counterclockwise.

skills.description_cn: 锁定技。结束阶段，你摸Y张牌（Y为本回合包括已死亡角色在内受到过伤害的角色数+1且至多为4）。
skills.description_en: Compulsory. During your End Phase, draw one plus the number of characters who Took damage this turn, including those who died, up to four cards.

source_reference.note: English translated from this pinned community rules record. The publisher confirms this name in the Shenmo box; compare the Chinese skills with your printed card to confirm its revision. Digital updates can differ from physical printings.

skills.description_cn: 出牌阶段限四次，你可以将一张♦牌当【乐不思蜀】使用或弃置场上一张【乐不思蜀】，然后你摸一张牌。
skills.description_en: Four times per Play Phase, you may Use a diamond card as Indulgence or discard an Indulgence on the field, then draw one card.

skills.description_cn: 当你成为【杀】的目标时，你可以弃置一张牌并选择你攻击范围内的一名不为此【杀】使用者的角色，将此【杀】转移给该角色。若你以此法弃置了♥牌，则你可以令一名不为此【杀】使用者的其他角色获得“流离”标记，且移去场上所有其他的“流离”（每回合限一次）。有“流离”的角色回合开始时，其移去其“流离”并执行一个额外的出牌阶段。
skills.description_en: When Slash targets you, you may discard one card and transfer it to a character within your Attack Range other than its user. If you discard a heart this way, once per turn you may give a different character other than the user a Drift token and remove all other Drift tokens. At the start of a Drift holder's turn, they remove it and perform an extra Play Phase.

skills.description_cn: 出牌阶段各限一次，你可以将一张牌交给一名其他角色，然后其选择一项：1. 其流失1点体力，你摸三张牌并获得一个「策」标记；2.其摸两张牌。（本阶段第二次执行选项时摸牌数-1）出牌阶段开始时，若你拥有「策」标记，你可以选择一名其他角色，对其造成X点伤害并移除所有「策」标记（X为你拥有的「策」标记数量）。
skills.description_en: During your Play Phase, you may give one card to another character, who chooses: Lose 1 HP, then you draw three cards and gain a Plan token; or draw two cards. Each option once per phase; on the second activation, reduce the chosen draw count by 1. At the start of your Play Phase, if you have Plan tokens, you may deal damage equal to their count to another character and remove all of them.

skills.description_cn: 锁定技。当你受到伤害后，防止你本回合受到的伤害。
skills.description_en: Compulsory. After you Take damage, prevent all further damage you would Take this turn.

source_reference.label: Chinese rules reference · Noname
source_reference.note: English translated from this pinned community rules record. The publisher confirms this name in the Shenmo box; compare the Chinese skills with your printed card to confirm its revision. Digital updates can differ from physical printings.

skills.description_cn: ①出牌阶段限一次。若你的武将牌正面朝上，你可以弃置至多两张牌，然后你翻面并获得等量护甲。②当你受到伤害后，若你的武将牌背面朝上，你可以选择一项：1.翻面；2.获得1点护甲。③当你翻面后，若你的武将牌正面朝上，你摸X张牌（X为你的护甲数）。
skills.description_en: Once per Play Phase, if face up, you may discard up to two cards, Flip your General Card, and gain that much Shield. After you Take damage while face down, you may Flip your General Card or gain 1 Shield. After you Flip face up, draw cards equal to your Shield.

skills.description_cn: 出牌阶段限一次。你可以失去1点护甲并选择一名其他角色。你观看其手牌并获得其中一张。
skills.description_en: Once per Play Phase, you may lose 1 Shield, look at another character's hand, and gain one card from it.

source_reference.label: Chinese rules reference · Noname
source_reference.note: English translated from this pinned community rules record. The publisher confirms this name in the Shenmo box; compare the Chinese skills with your printed card to confirm its revision. Digital updates can differ from physical printings.

skills.description_cn: ①当一名角色受到伤害后（每回合限一次）或死亡时，你获得2个“颂”标记（你至多拥有9个“颂”标记）。②出牌阶段限两次，你可以：1.移去2个“颂”标记，令一名角色复原武将牌；2.移去2个“颂”标记，令一名角色摸三张牌；3.移去3个“颂”标记，令一名体力上限小于10的角色回复1点体力，增加1点体力上限，随机恢复一个已废除的装备栏；4.移去4个“颂”标记，获得一名阵亡角色武将牌上除主公技外的所有技能，然后你失去〖行殇〗、〖放逐〗和〖颂威〗。
skills.description_en: Gain two Praise tokens after a character Takes damage, once per turn, or dies, up to nine tokens. Twice per Play Phase, you may spend: 2 to restore a character's General Card face up and not sideways; 2 to have a character draw three cards; 3 to have a character with Max HP below 10 recover 1 HP, increase Max HP by 1, and restore one random abolished equipment slot; or 4 to gain all non-Lord skills on a dead character's General Card, then lose Mourn the Fallen, Exile, and Praised Might.

skills.description_cn: 出牌阶段限一次，你可以：1.移去2个“颂”标记，令一名其他角色于手牌中只能使用基本牌直到其回合结束；2.移去6个“颂”标记，令一名其他角色于手牌中只能使用锦囊牌直到其回合结束；3.移去8个“颂”标记，令一名其他角色于手牌中只能使用装备牌直到其回合结束；4.移去6个“颂”标记，令一名其他角色的非Charlotte技能失效直到其回合结束；5.移去4个“颂”标记，令一名其他角色不能响应另一名角色使用的牌直到其回合结束；6.移去8个“颂”标记，令一名其他角色将武将牌翻面。
skills.description_en: Once per Play Phase, spend Praise tokens for an effect on another character until their turn ends: 2, their hand cards may only be Used as Basic Cards; 6, only Tool Cards; 8, only Equipment Cards; 6, disable their non-Charlotte skills; 4, prevent them responding to cards Used by another chosen character. Alternatively, spend 8 to Flip their General Card. Charlotte is the source engine's category for persistent rules effects.

skills.description_cn: 主公技，出牌阶段开始时，你获得Y个“颂”标记（Y为场上其他魏势力角色数的两倍）。
skills.description_en: Lord. At the start of your Play Phase, gain twice as many Praise tokens as there are other Wei characters.

skills.description_cn: ①游戏开始时，你可获得至多2枚“治世”标记。②当你受到伤害后，你可获得伤害牌，摸3-X张牌（X为“治世”数），然后你可弃1枚“治世”。
skills.description_en: At game start, you may gain up to two Governance tokens. After you Take damage, you may gain the damage card and draw 3-X cards, where X is your Governance count, then you may remove one Governance token.

skills.description_cn: 出牌阶段开始时，你可以弃置3-X种花色的所有手牌（X为“治世”数），并观看一名有手牌的其他角色的手牌，你弃置其中一种花色的所有牌。若其被弃置的牌数小于你以此法弃置的牌数，你对其造成1点伤害。然后若X小于2且你拥有技能〖奸雄〗，你可以获得1枚“治世”。
skills.description_en: At the start of your Play Phase, you may discard all hand cards of 3-X suits, where X is your Governance count, then look at another character's nonempty hand and discard all cards of one suit from it. If they lose fewer cards than you discarded, deal 1 damage to them. If X is below 2 and you have Ambitious Hero, you may gain one Governance token.

skills.description_cn: 主公技，每轮限一次。当你受到伤害时，你可以将此伤害转移给一名其他魏势力角色。
skills.description_en: Lord; once per round. When you Take damage, you may transfer it to another Wei character.

skills.description_cn: 锁定技，你造成的伤害改为火焰伤害；有角色受到火焰伤害后，你摸一张牌或令一号位回复1点体力。
skills.description_en: Compulsory. Damage you deal becomes fire damage. After any character Takes fire damage, draw one card or have the character in seat 1 recover 1 HP.

skills.description_cn: 你可以视为使用一张无距离次数限制的基本牌或普通锦囊牌并摸三张牌，然后此技能失效直到你使用了九张牌。
skills.description_en: You may be treated as Using a Basic or Non-Time-Delayed Tool Card with no distance or usage limit and draw three cards. Disable this skill until you have Used nine cards.

skills.description_cn: 限定技，回合结束时，你可执行一个使用牌无次数限制的额外回合，此回合结束时，若你此回合杀死了其他角色，你须重新发动此技能，否则你死亡。
skills.description_en: Limited. At turn end, you may take an extra turn in which card Uses have no usage limits. At its end, if you killed another character during it, you must activate this skill again; otherwise, you die.

skills.description_cn: 锁定技，你造成和受到的伤害改为体力流失；有角色失去体力后，你摸一张牌。
skills.description_en: Compulsory. Damage you deal and Take becomes HP loss. After any character Loses HP, draw one card.

skills.description_cn: 出牌阶段限一次，你可以选择任意名其他角色，你摸这些角色数张牌，令这些角色视为对你使用一张无距离限制的【杀】，然后你弃置其中任意名角色各一张牌，此技能失效直到所有角色失去了9点体力。
skills.description_en: Once per Play Phase, choose any number of other characters and draw that many cards. Have each be treated as Using Slash on you with no distance limit, then discard one card from each of any number of those characters. Disable this skill until characters have Lost a total of 9 HP.

skills.description_cn: 限定技，回合结束时，你可以减少任意点体力上限并进行等量使用牌没有次数限制的额外回合，所有额外回合结束后，你死亡。
skills.description_en: Limited. At turn end, you may reduce your Max HP by any amount and take that many extra turns in which card Uses have no usage limits. After all those extra turns, you die.
